Come Assembler, sei responsabile dell'assemblaggio professionale dei prodotti semilavorati e finiti del trasformatore. Utilizzando utensili manuali e di potenza e documentazione tecnica, si effettuano compiti di montaggio assegnati in modo preciso e affidabile. Assicuratevi che i nostri prodotti soddisfino standard di alta qualità e sicurezza. Lavorate a stretto contatto con il vostro team, documentate eventuali deviazioni e, una volta sufficientemente sperimentate, supportate la formazione di nuovi dipendenti.

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Assemblare i prodotti semilavorati e finiti del trasformatore utilizzando utensili manuali e di potenza
• Leggere e interpretare disegni tecnici, progetti e specifiche per garantire un assemblaggio accurato
• Eseguire controlli di qualità regolari su prodotti semilavorati e finiti, identificare e segnalare difetti o deviazioni
• Documento e relazione problemi di qualità e informare i supervisori sui progressi del lavoro
• Seguire costantemente le normative sulla salute e sulla sicurezza e segnalare eventuali preoccupazioni di sicurezza o non conformità
• Mantenere un posto di lavoro pulito, organizzato e ben strutturato
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con i membri del team e sostenere la formazione di nuovi dipendenti nei processi di assemblaggio e nelle migliori pratiche una volta che le competenze richieste sono state acquisite
• Partecipare a riunioni regolari di sicurezza sul posto di lavoro e sessioni di formazione, seguendo procedure di lavoro e programmi di produzione consolidati

Il tuo sfondo

• L'istruzione obbligatoria completa o equivalente; l'istruzione tecnica o la certificazione è un vantaggio
• Esperienza precedente nel montaggio o un ruolo paragonabile in un ambiente di produzione o di produzione
• Comprensione di base dei componenti elettrici e dei processi di montaggio
• Capacità di leggere e comprendere disegni tecnici, progetti e documentazione
• Forte attenzione ai dettagli, una mentalità focalizzata sulla qualità e un alto livello di consapevolezza della sicurezza

jobs.title: Research Scientist – Experimental Reliability Physics (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Empower the Future with Hitachi Energy: Join us as a Scientist in Physics of Failure & Reliability and apply first-principles thinking and scientific methods to develop innovative reliability engineering approaches that contribute to the success of a technology-driven company.

We are looking for a passionate and proficient scientist to join us in reliability research for power grid assets and systems. As part of our dynamic, motivated, and creative team, you will bridge theory and application through experimental research, developing, designing, testing, and validating novel methods and technologies to understand degradation mechanisms and improve the reliability of future power grid assets.

How you'll make an impact

• You drive impact: Lead and contribute to cross-functional projects by focusing on the underlying physics of failure, ensuring that reliability enhancements for power grid assets are grounded in a deep understanding of how application stresses translate into real-world failure mechanisms. Design and execute experiments to investigate degradation and failure mechanisms under realistic operating conditions

• You innovate: Proactively seek out emerging knowledge in failure physics and develop novel experimental approaches to validate scientific hypotheses and improve system reliability, keeping the team at the cutting edge of reliability science and its practical applications

• You take initiative: Collaborate with a global team of researchers and engineers in Hitachi Energy Research and Hitachi Energy business units. Help identify and solve real-world problems, inspire opportunities for further improvement, and contribute to accelerating the implementation of innovative technologies

• You connect: Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise

• You communicate: Disseminate your results through scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports

Your background

• PhD in experimental physics, materials science, electrical engineering, or a related field

• Expertise in physics of failure, failure investigation, root-cause analysis, and reliability modeling, combined with strong data analysis skills and accurate interpretation of results

• Hands-on experience in designing and conducting experiments, developing test methods, and using advanced materials characterization techniques to investigate degradation and failure mechanisms

• Industry or post-doctoral experience in energy technology or related industries such as automotive, rail, aerospace, or telecommunications, with a focus on product reliability improvements, is a plus

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken

More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Additionally, you can expect:

• Work on cutting-edge technologies

• Opportunity to grow into a technical expert within a rapidly developing business

• Collaboration within a highly skilled, international R&D team

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Potenziare il Futuro con Hitachi Energy: Unisciti a noi come Scienziato in Fisica di Fallimento e Affidabilità e applicare metodi di pensiero e scientifici di primo piano per sviluppare approcci innovativi di ingegneria dell'affidabilità che contribuiscono al successo di una società basata sulla tecnologia.

Stiamo cercando uno scienziato appassionato e competente per unirsi a noi nella ricerca di affidabilità per le attività e i sistemi di rete elettrica. Nell'ambito del nostro team dinamico, motivato e creativo, collaborerai la teoria e l'applicazione attraverso la ricerca sperimentale, lo sviluppo, la progettazione, il test e la validazione di nuovi metodi e tecnologie per comprendere i meccanismi di degradazione e migliorare l'affidabilità dei futuri asset della rete elettrica.

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Guidare l'impatto: portare e contribuire a progetti interfunzionali concentrandosi sulla fisica sottostante del fallimento, assicurando che i miglioramenti dell'affidabilità per le attività della rete elettrica sono fondati in una profonda comprensione di come le sollecitazioni dell'applicazione si traducono in meccanismi di fallimento del mondo reale. Progettare ed eseguire esperimenti per indagare i meccanismi di degrado e di fallimento in condizioni operative realistiche

• Innovare: Proattivamente cercare le conoscenze emergenti nella fisica dei guasti e sviluppare nuovi approcci sperimentali per convalidare le ipotesi scientifiche e migliorare l'affidabilità del sistema, mantenendo il team all'avanguardia della scienza dell'affidabilità e delle sue applicazioni pratiche

• Si prende l'iniziativa: collaborare con un team globale di ricercatori e ingegneri nelle unità aziendali Hitachi Energy Research e Hitachi Energy. Aiuta a identificare e risolvere i problemi del mondo reale, ispirare opportunità di ulteriore miglioramento e contribuire ad accelerare l'implementazione di tecnologie innovative

• Ti connetti: Costruire relazioni all'interno dell'azienda e condividere attivamente le tue conoscenze e competenze

• Comunica: Dissemina i tuoi risultati attraverso pubblicazioni scientifiche, domande di brevetti e relazioni tecniche

Il tuo sfondo

• PhD in fisica sperimentale, scienza dei materiali, ingegneria elettrica, o un campo correlato

• Competenza nella fisica del fallimento, delle indagini di fallimento, dell'analisi delle cause della radice e della modellazione dell'affidabilità, unita a forti capacità di analisi dei dati e all'accurata interpretazione dei risultati

• Esperienza pratica nella progettazione e nella conduzione di esperimenti, nello sviluppo di metodi di prova e nell'utilizzo di tecniche di caratterizzazione dei materiali avanzate per indagare i meccanismi di degradazione e di fallimento

• L'industria o l'esperienza post-dottorale nella tecnologia dell'energia o nelle industrie connesse, come l'automotive, la ferrovia, l'aerospaziale o le telecomunicazioni, con un focus sui miglioramenti dell'affidabilità del prodotto, è un plus

• Fluency in inglese, scritto e parlato

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

Inoltre, puoi aspettarti:

• Lavori su tecnologie all'avanguardia

• Opportunità di crescere in un esperto tecnico all'interno di un business in rapido sviluppo

• Collaborazione all'interno di un team R&D altamente qualificato e internazionale

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance

Befähigen Sie die Zukunft mit Hitachi Energy: Schließen Sie sich uns als Wissenschaftler in Physik des Scheiterns und der Zuverlässigkeit an und wenden Sie erstklassiges Denken und wissenschaftliche Methoden an, um innovative Zuverlässigkeitskonzepte zu entwickeln, die zum Erfolg eines technologiegetriebenen Unternehmens beitragen.

Wir suchen einen leidenschaftlichen und kompetenten Wissenschaftler, der sich uns in der Zuverlässigkeitsforschung für Stromnetzanlagen und -systeme anschließt. Als Teil unseres dynamischen, motivierten und kreativen Teams verbinden Sie Theorie und Anwendung durch experimentelle Forschung, Entwicklung, Design, Test und Validierung neuer Methoden und Technologien, um Degradationsmechanismen zu verstehen und die Zuverlässigkeit zukünftiger Stromnetzanlagen zu verbessern.

Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen werden

• Sie fördern die Wirkung: Führen und leisten Sie einen Beitrag zu funktionsübergreifenden Projekten, indem Sie sich auf die zugrunde liegende Physik des Versagens konzentrieren und sicherstellen, dass Zuverlässigkeitsverbesserungen für Stromnetzanlagen auf einem tiefen Verständnis davon basieren, wie sich Anwendungsbelastungen in reale Ausfallmechanismen verwandeln. Entwurf und Durchführung von Experimenten zur Untersuchung von Degradations- und Ausfallmechanismen unter realistischen Betriebsbedingungen

• Sie innovieren: Proaktiv nach neuem Wissen in der Fehlerphysik suchen und neuartige experimentelle Ansätze entwickeln, um wissenschaftliche Hypothesen zu validieren und die Systemzuverlässigkeit zu verbessern und das Team an der Spitze der Zuverlässigkeitswissenschaft und ihrer praktischen Anwendungen zu halten

• Sie ergreifen Initiative: Arbeiten Sie mit einem globalen Team von Forschern und Ingenieuren in den Geschäftsbereichen Hitachi Energy Research und Hitachi Energy zusammen. Helfen Sie, reale Probleme zu identifizieren und zu lösen, Möglichkeiten für weitere Verbesserungen zu schaffen und zur Beschleunigung der Implementierung innovativer Technologien beizutragen

• Du verbindest dich: Baue Beziehungen innerhalb des Unternehmens auf und teile aktiv dein Wissen und deine Expertise

• Sie kommunizieren: Verbreiten Sie Ihre Ergebnisse durch wissenschaftliche Publikationen, Patentanmeldungen und technische Berichte

Dein Hintergrund

• PhD in experimenteller Physik, Materialwissenschaften, Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Expertise in der Physik des Versagens, der Fehleruntersuchung, der Ursachenanalyse und der Zuverlässigkeitsmodellierung, kombiniert mit starken Datenanalysefähigkeiten und einer genauen Interpretation der Ergebnisse

• Praktische Erfahrung in der Gestaltung und Durchführung von Experimenten, der Entwicklung von Testmethoden und der Verwendung fortschrittlicher Materialcharakterisierungstechniken zur Untersuchung von Abbau- und Versagensmechanismen

• Industrie- oder Postdoktorandenerfahrung in der Energietechnologie oder verwandten Branchen wie Automobil, Schiene, Luft- und Raumfahrt oder Telekommunikation, mit Schwerpunkt auf Verbesserungen der Produktzuverlässigkeit, ist ein Plus

• fließend in Englisch, sowohl geschrieben als auch gesprochen

Mehr über uns

Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsweisen helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.

Darüber hinaus können Sie erwarten:

• Arbeiten an Spitzentechnologien

• Möglichkeit, in einem sich schnell entwickelnden Unternehmen zu einem technischen Experten zu werden

• Zusammenarbeit in einem hochqualifizierten, internationalen R&D Team
descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'opportunité

Empower the Future with Hitachi Energy: Joignez-vous à nous en tant que scientifique en physique de l'échec et de la fiabilité et appliquez les premiers principes de la pensée et des méthodes scientifiques pour développer des approches innovantes d'ingénierie de la fiabilité qui contribuent au succès d'une entreprise axée sur la technologie.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un scientifique passionné et compétent pour nous rejoindre dans la recherche de fiabilité pour les actifs et les systèmes du réseau électrique. Dans le cadre de notre équipe dynamique, motivée et créative, vous relierez la théorie et l'application par la recherche expérimentale, le développement, la conception, l'essai et la validation de nouvelles méthodes et technologies pour comprendre les mécanismes de dégradation et améliorer la fiabilité des futurs réseaux électriques.

Comment vous allez avoir un impact

• Vous conduisez l'impact : dirigez et contribuez à des projets interfonctionnels en se concentrant sur la physique sous-jacente de la défaillance, en veillant à ce que les améliorations de la fiabilité des actifs du réseau électrique soient ancrées dans une compréhension approfondie de la façon dont les contraintes d'application se traduisent en mécanismes de défaillance du monde réel. Concevoir et exécuter des expériences pour étudier les mécanismes de dégradation et de défaillance dans des conditions de fonctionnement réalistes

• Vous innovez: recherche proactive de nouvelles connaissances en physique des échecs et développez de nouvelles approches expérimentales pour valider les hypothèses scientifiques et améliorer la fiabilité du système, en maintenant l'équipe à la pointe de la science de la fiabilité et de ses applications pratiques

• Vous prenez l'initiative : Collaborez avec une équipe mondiale de chercheurs et d'ingénieurs dans Hitachi Energy Research et Hitachi Energy. Aider à identifier et à résoudre les problèmes réels, à susciter des possibilités d'amélioration et à accélérer la mise en œuvre de technologies innovantes

• Vous vous connectez : établir des relations au sein de l'entreprise et partager activement vos connaissances et votre expertise

• Vous communiquez : Diffuser vos résultats au moyen de publications scientifiques, de demandes de brevets et de rapports techniques

Vos antécédents

• Doctorat en physique expérimentale, sciences des matériaux, génie électrique ou un domaine connexe

• Expertise en physique de l'échec, enquête sur l'échec, analyse des causes profondes et modélisation de la fiabilité, associée à de solides compétences en analyse de données et interprétation précise des résultats

• Expérience pratique dans la conception et la conduite d'expériences, l'élaboration de méthodes d'essai et l'utilisation de techniques avancées de caractérisation des matériaux pour étudier les mécanismes de dégradation et de défaillance

• L'expérience de l'industrie ou postdoctorale dans les technologies énergétiques ou les industries connexes comme l'automobile, le rail, l'aérospatiale ou les télécommunications, en mettant l'accent sur l'amélioration de la fiabilité des produits, est un plus

• Connaissance de l'anglais, écrit et parlé

Plus sur nous

Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et commerciale tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et croître.

En outre, vous pouvez vous attendre:

• Travaux sur les technologies de pointe

• Possibilité de devenir un expert technique dans une entreprise en développement rapide

• Collaboration au sein d'une équipe internationale de R-D hautement qualifiée

jobs.title: Operational Excellence Workstream Project Manager 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Are you passionate about driving transformation, improving operational performance, and turning strategic priorities into tangible results?
We are looking for an Operational Excellence Workstream Project Manager to lead strategic improvement and transformation initiatives supporting our growth, scalability, productivity, and execution excellence ambitions.

In this role, you will work across functions, business units, and regions, bringing together diverse stakeholders to drive operational excellence initiatives from planning through implementation and benefits realization.

How you'll make an impact

• Lead strategic operational excellence and transformation initiatives within the Scale to Potential program across functions and regions
• Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones, resources, and implementation roadmaps in collaboration with Operational Excellence leadership and key stakeholders
• Develop and maintain integrated workstream plans, track progress and KPIs, and ensure successful delivery against agreed commitments
• Identify and manage risks, issues, and dependencies, driving timely decisions and corrective actions to keep initiatives on track
• Establish effective governance, reporting, and performance reviews while promoting standard processes, best practices, and lessons learned
• Drive stakeholder engagement and change management, supporting the successful adoption of new processes, tools, governance models, and ways of working
• Coordinate cross-functional teams and foster collaboration, accountability, and knowledge sharing across organizational and geographical boundaries
• Track benefits realization and business impact, ensuring initiatives contribute to productivity, scalability, execution excellence, digitalization, and sustainable performance improvements
Your background

• Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, Business Administration, Project Management, Operations Management, or a related field
• Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in project or program management, operational excellence, business transformation, or continuous improvement
• Demonstrated experience leading complex cross-functional projects or transformation initiatives, ideally within a global organization
• Strong project management capabilities, including planning, governance, resource coordination, risk management, execution, and performance tracking
• Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, Project Management, or comparable operational excellence and improvement methodologies is an advantage
• Strong stakeholder and change management skills with the ability to create alignment and drive execution within a matrix organization
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate strategic priorities and performance insights into concrete actions
• Excellent communication skills in English and influencing skills with the ability to work effectively with stakeholders across functions, regions, and organizational levels
More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

The minimum salary for this position in the location Italy specified:

• Starting from: 52,700 € gross annual salary
• Applicable CBA: Metalmeccanico
The final offer will be based on candidate location, skills and qualifications, experience, and aligned with internal pay structures. This role may be open in multiple locations. If the salary information listed is not applicable for your current home location, salary details relevant to your location will be discussed with you at a later stage.

Our benefit offering is tailored based on your country of employment and generally includes:

• Competitive salary and incentives
• Well-being and care
• Paid and unpaid leave
• Flexible work options
• Benefits that support your financial security
You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process.

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile di progetto del workstream di eccellenza operativa 80 – 100% (m/f/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Sei appassionato della trasformazione della guida, del miglioramento delle prestazioni operative e della trasformazione delle priorità strategiche in risultati tangibili?
Stiamo cercando un Operational Excellence Workstream Project Manager per condurre iniziative di miglioramento strategico e di trasformazione che supportino le nostre ambizioni di crescita, scalabilità, produttività e eccellenza di esecuzione.

In questo ruolo, lavorerai tra funzioni, unità aziendali e regioni, mettendo insieme diversi stakeholder per guidare iniziative di eccellenza operativa dalla pianificazione attraverso l'implementazione e la realizzazione dei benefici.

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Guidare iniziative strategiche di eccellenza operativa e di trasformazione all'interno del programma Scale to Potential attraverso funzioni e regioni
• Definire la portata del progetto, gli obiettivi, i risultati, le pietre miliari, le risorse e le roadmap di attuazione in collaborazione con la leadership di Operational Excellence e i principali stakeholder
• Sviluppare e mantenere piani integrati a flusso di lavoro, monitorare i progressi e i KPI, e garantire la consegna di successo contro gli impegni concordati
• Identificare e gestire rischi, problemi e dipendenze, guidare decisioni tempestive e azioni correttive per mantenere in pista iniziative
• Stabilire recensioni efficaci di governance, reporting e prestazioni, promuovendo processi standard, best practice e lezioni apprese
• Guidare l'impegno e la gestione dei cambiamenti degli stakeholder, sostenendo l'adozione di nuovi processi, strumenti, modelli di governance e modi di lavoro
• Coordinare i team interfunzionali e favorire la collaborazione, la responsabilità e la condivisione delle conoscenze attraverso i confini organizzativi e geografici
• Traccia la realizzazione e l'impatto aziendale, assicurando che le iniziative contribuiscano a produttività, scalabilità, eccellenza dell'esecuzione, digitalizzazione e miglioramenti delle prestazioni sostenibili
Il tuo sfondo

• Laurea o master in ingegneria, Business Administration, Project Management, gestione delle operazioni, o un campo relativo
• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza professionale rilevante nella gestione del progetto o del programma, eccellenza operativa, trasformazione aziendale, o miglioramento continuo
• Esperienza dimostrata che conduce complessi progetti interfunzionali o iniziative di trasformazione, idealmente all'interno di un'organizzazione globale
• Forte capacità di gestione del progetto, tra cui pianificazione, governance, coordinamento delle risorse, gestione del rischio, esecuzione e monitoraggio delle prestazioni
• L'esperienza con Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, Project Management, o simili metodologie operative e di miglioramento è un vantaggio
• Forte stakeholder e capacità di gestione dei cambiamenti con la capacità di creare allineamento e l'esecuzione di unità all'interno di un'organizzazione di matrice
• Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving, con la capacità di tradurre priorità strategiche e insight sulle prestazioni in azioni concrete
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione in inglese e influenzare le competenze con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente con gli stakeholder attraverso funzioni, regioni e livelli organizzativi
Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

Lo stipendio minimo per questa posizione nella posizione Italia specificato:

• A partire da: 52.700 € salario annuo lordo
• CBA applicabile: Metalmeccanico
L'offerta finale si baserà sulla posizione del candidato, le competenze e le qualifiche, l'esperienza, e allineato con strutture di pagamento interne. Questo ruolo può essere aperto in più posizioni. Se le informazioni sullo stipendio elencate non sono applicabili per la vostra posizione attuale, i dettagli dello stipendio relativi alla vostra posizione saranno discussi con voi in una fase successiva.

La nostra offerta di benefici è su misura in base al vostro paese di lavoro e in genere include:

• Competitività e incentivi
• Benessere e cura
• congedo pagato e non pagato
• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili
• Vantaggi che supportano la sicurezza finanziaria
Riceverai informazioni più specifiche durante il processo di reclutamento.

Die Chance

Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, die Transformation voranzutreiben, die operative Leistung zu verbessern und strategische Prioritäten in greifbare Ergebnisse zu verwandeln?
Wir suchen einen Operational Excellence Workstream Project Manager, der strategische Verbesserungs- und Transformationsinitiativen leitet, die unsere Ambitionen in den Bereichen Wachstum, Skalierbarkeit, Produktivität und Ausführung unterstützen.

In dieser Rolle arbeiten Sie über Funktionen, Geschäftseinheiten und Regionen hinweg und bringen verschiedene Interessengruppen zusammen, um operative Exzellenzinitiativen von der Planung über die Implementierung bis hin zur Realisierung von Vorteilen voranzutreiben.

Wie Sie einen Einfluss machen werden

• Führen Sie strategische operative Exzellenz- und Transformationsinitiativen innerhalb des Scale to Potential-Programms über Funktionen und Regionen hinweg
• Definieren Sie Projektumfang, Ziele, Ergebnisse, Meilensteine, Ressourcen und Umsetzungs-Roadmaps in Zusammenarbeit mit der Führung von Operational Excellence und wichtigen Stakeholdern
• Entwicklung und Pflege integrierter Workstream-Pläne, Verfolgung von Fortschritten und KPIs und Sicherstellung einer erfolgreichen Umsetzung der vereinbarten Verpflichtungen
• Identifizieren und Verwalten von Risiken, Problemen und Abhängigkeiten, zeitnahe Entscheidungen und Korrekturmaßnahmen, um Initiativen auf Kurs zu halten
• Etablieren Sie effektive Governance-, Berichts- und Leistungsüberprüfungen und fördern Sie Standardprozesse, Best Practices und gewonnene Erkenntnisse
• Förderung von Stakeholder-Engagement und Change Management, Unterstützung der erfolgreichen Einführung neuer Prozesse, Tools, Governance-Modelle und Arbeitsweisen
• Koordinieren Sie funktionsübergreifende Teams und fördern Sie Zusammenarbeit, Rechenschaftspflicht und Wissensaustausch über organisatorische und geografische Grenzen hinweg
• Verfolgen Sie die Vorteile der Realisierung und der Geschäftsauswirkungen und stellen Sie sicher, dass Initiativen zur Produktivität, Skalierbarkeit, Ausführungsqualität, Digitalisierung und nachhaltigen Leistungsverbesserungen beitragen
Dein Hintergrund

• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Engineering, Business Administration, Projektmanagement, Operations Management oder einem verwandten Bereich

jobs.description:
The opportunity

Are you passionate about turning data into meaningful insights and helping organizations improve how they deliver projects?
We are looking for a Project Portfolio & Operational Performance Analyst to strengthen our Project Execution Excellence organization. In this role, you will bring together project, portfolio, and operational data to create transparency, identify improvement opportunities, and support fact-based decision-making across the business.
You will work closely with project operations, portfolio management, operational excellence teams, and senior stakeholders, providing the insights needed to improve execution performance and drive continuous improvement.

How you'll make an impact

• Develop and maintain KPIs, dashboards, scorecards, and performance reports for project, portfolio, and operational performance
• Monitor and analyze key metrics including schedule, cost, profitability, quality, project health, resource utilization, and risk exposure
• Identify trends, deviations, risks, and performance gaps and translate your findings into actionable recommendations
• Prepare and support portfolio, operational, and management performance reviews, ensuring transparent and reliable information for decision-making
• Partner with project and business teams to define corrective actions and improvement initiatives and track their implementation and impact
• Provide data-driven insights to support portfolio prioritization, resource allocation, risk management, and business planning
• Improve the quality, consistency, and reliability of project and operational data in collaboration with business functions and system owners
• Support operational excellence, maturity assessments, benchmarking, and continuous improvement initiatives aligned with our Project Execution Excellence strategy
Your background

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Project Management, Operations Management, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field
• Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in project management, PMO, project controls, portfolio management, business analytics, operational excellence, or performance management
• Good understanding of project execution, governance, portfolio management, planning and scheduling, risk management, and operational performance
• Proven experience developing KPIs, dashboards, scorecards, analytical models, and management reporting
• Experience analyzing performance data and translating findings into practical improvement initiatives and business recommendations
• Hands-on knowledge of reporting and analytics solutions such as Power BI, SAP Analytics, Microsoft Power Platform, or comparable tools
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with the ability to communicate complex information in a clear and practical way
• Strong stakeholder management skills and fluency in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and organizational levels
More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.description:
The opportunity
Are you ready to take your career to the next level? We are looking for an experienced, enthusiastic, and highly motivated self-driven tender specialist to strengthen the Global Competence Center Power Conversion team part of Power Grids Grid Integration Business Unit.

In this position you are responsible for tendering the Grid Integration portfolio with focus on Power Conversion (Static Frequency System Applications) Solutions. Your role is to create competitive bids, estimates, and quotations for our innovative solutions. You'll work closely with an interdisciplinary team and external partners to ensure that we offer the best solutions to meet our customers' needs around the globe.

jobs.title: Assembler 80 - 100% (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity
As an Assembler, you are responsible for the professional assembly of semi-finished and finished transformer products. Using hand and power tools as well as technical documentation, you carry out assigned assembly tasks accurately and reliably. You ensure that our products meet high quality and safety standards. You work closely with your team, document any deviations and, once sufficiently experienced, support the training of new employees.

How you'll make an impact

• Assemble semi-finished and finished transformer products using hand and power tools
• Read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints and specifications to ensure accurate assembly
• Perform regular quality inspections on semi-finished and finished products, identifying and reporting defects or deviations
• Document and report quality issues and inform supervisors about work progress
• Consistently follow health and safety regulations and report any safety concerns or non-compliance
• Maintain a clean, organized and well-structured workplace
• Collaborate closely with team members and support the training of new employees in assembly processes and best practices once the required skills have been acquired
• Participate in regular workplace safety meetings and training sessions, while following established work procedures and production schedules

Your background

• Completed compulsory education or equivalent; technical education or certification is an advantage
• Previous experience in assembly or a comparable role in a manufacturing or production environment
• Basic understanding of electrical components and assembly processes
• Ability to read and understand technical drawings, blueprints and documentation
• Strong attention to detail, a quality-focused mindset and a high level of safety awareness
• Good manual dexterity, physical ability to lift and handle heavy components, as well as a reliable and collaborative approach to work

More about us
Hitachi Energy is shaping the future of energy with innovative technologies for a sustainable and reliable power supply. We offer a modern working environment, a strong team and the opportunity to contribute to forward-looking solutions.

descriptionByLocale.en:
About the position
As a maintenance and maintenance technician, you ensure the high availability, reliability and operational reliability of our production facilities, automation systems and technical infrastructures at the Wettingen site. You support production through professional troubleshooting, preventive maintenance and technical optimizations. In doing so, you work closely with different specialist areas and actively contribute to the continuous development of our plants and to make our production processes more efficient and reliable.

You can do that.

• Ensuring reliable operation of our production facilities, automation systems and technical infrastructure as well as carrying out plant inspections and condition assessments

• Analysis and correction of mechanical, electrical, pneumatic and automation malfunctions including root cause analysis and sustainable implementation of corrective measures

• Implementation of preventive maintenance and inspection work according to maintenance plans as well as continuous improvement of maintenance standards and maintenance processes

• Supporting production in the event of technical problems and ensuring compliance with technical standards, quality requirements and safety requirements

• Identification and implementation of technical improvements to increase plant availability, productivity and quality as well as participation in lean, TPM and operational excellence initiatives

• Support for plant optimisation, conversion, modernisation and technical investment projects

• Cooperation in the management of critical spare parts and ensuring the technical availability of necessary components

• Documentation of faults, maintenance work and improvement measures in the maintenance system as well as compliance with safety and compliance requirements

You bring that with you

• Completed technical vocational training as an automatic, mechatronic, polymechanic, electromechanic or equivalent technical training

• Experience in maintenance of industrial production facilities and knowledge of mechanics, pneumatics, electrical engineering and automation

• Knowledge of PLC controls, robotics and industrial automation systems is advantageous

• Experience with SAP PM, maintenance management systems or similar tools as well as an understanding of TPM, lean and operational excellence methods

• Structured, analytical and solution-oriented working method with high problem-solving competence and strong security awareness

• Teamwork, service orientation and willingness to cooperate in shift operations and pikett service

More about us
Hitachi Energy is shaping the energy future with innovative technologies for a sustainable and reliable energy supply. With us, you can expect a modern working environment, a strong team and the opportunity to actively participate in future-oriented solutions.

jobs.title: Project Manager Secondary Engineering 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

We are looking for a Project Manager for Secondary Engineering to join our team. In this role, you will manage secondary engineering projects (LCC local control cabinets) from handover from sales until the end of installation, including engineering and production in collaboration with primary engineering and under the leadership of the Commercial Project Manager of the GIS Project.

How you'll make an impact

• Lead secondary engineering projects from handover from sales, clarification of specifications, and full project management scope (scope, time, cost)
• Lead engineering activities with the extended workbench (base design and detail design)
• Detect deviations and claims, clarify with customers, and conduct customer meetings
• Achieve design freeze and customer approval, create production documents, and support production in feeder factories or supplier factories
• Conduct final acceptance tests with customers, support site installation and commissioning, and create as-built documents for project close-out
• Actively participate in project reporting structures such as the digital project board
• Assist with sales and tender processes and provide support to the production line
• Contribute to development projects and improvement initiatives

Your background

• Degree in electrical Engineering background
• Min. 5 years experience in engineering of secondary projects and project management
• Financial and technical competence for executing secondary projects according to internal guidelines
• Fluency in English is required; fluency in German and other languages is desired
• Experience with Zuken E3 is a plus
• Independent, well-structured, and autonomous way of working with self-control of work and associated actions
• Responsibility for technical and standard-compliant project execution, coordination with upstream and downstream departments, and compliance with applicable standards and regulations (ISO 9001, 14001, OHSAS 18001)
• Solid background in managing and aligning key stakeholders
• Experience coordinating cross-functional activities and initiatives
• Approx. 10% travel required

More about us

Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader advancing a sustainable energy future for all. You will work in a collaborative and international environment where innovation, learning, and continuous improvement are part of everyday work.

• Contribuire a progetti di sviluppo e iniziative di miglioramento

• Esperienza di 5 anni nell'ingegneria dei progetti secondari e nella gestione dei progetti

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Sei un leader esperto con una passione per la produzione di semiconduttori, l'ingegneria e lo sviluppo delle persone? Stiamo cercando un Team Lead Product Engineering BiMOS per guidare un team di ingegneri altamente qualificati e tecnici e guidare l'eccellenza tecnica, le prestazioni operative e il miglioramento continuo attraverso le nostre operazioni di semiconduttore. Il ruolo sarà parte dell'organizzazione Product Engineering BiMOS.

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Guidare, allenare e sviluppare un team di ingegneri del prodotto, favorendo una cultura ad alte prestazioni
• Guidare la responsabilità e sostenere i dipendenti nel raggiungere il loro pieno potenziale attraverso aspettative chiare, feedback regolari e sviluppo professionale
• Miglioramento del rendimento di piombo, miglioramento della qualità e attività di ottimizzazione dei costi
• Assicurare la proprietà end-to-end del prodotto che copre qualità, affidabilità, manufacturability e prestazioni del prodotto
• Collabora con R&D, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality e Product Management
• Sostenere l'industrializzazione e il trasferimento di nuove tecnologie e prodotti nella produzione ad alto volume
• Priorizzare le risorse, rimuovere gli ostacoli e garantire un'efficace esecuzione degli obiettivi strategici
• Miglioramento continuo e eccellenza operativa in tutta l'organizzazione
Il tuo sfondo

• Laurea in ingegneria elettrica, fisica, scienza dei materiali, tecnologia dei semiconduttori o un campo correlato
• Diversi anni di esperienza nella produzione di semiconduttori, ingegneria dei prodotti, ingegneria dei processi o ingegneria della qualità
• Provata esperienza di leadership con un forte record di costruzione, motivare e sviluppare squadre ad alto rendimento
• Capacità dimostrata di affrontare le lacune delle prestazioni e portare attivamente le persone al livello di prestazione richiesto attraverso coaching, feedback e piani di sviluppo strutturati
• Forte capacità analitiche, problem solving e decisionali
• Eccellente capacità di gestione e comunicazione degli stakeholder
• Le competenze linguistiche fluenti sono obbligatorie
Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

Crediamo che il grande lavoro prosperi in un ambiente in cui le persone si sentono sinceramente sostenute e abbastanza ricompensate. I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per creare valore reale per ogni individuo – il rifornimento di impegno, le prestazioni e la crescita. Costruire un posto di lavoro dove il successo personale e organizzativo crescono insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

Are you an experienced leader with a passion for semiconductor manufacturing, engineering, and people development? We are looking for a Team Lead Product Engineering BiMOS to lead a team of highly skilled Engineers and Technician and drive technical excellence, operational performance, and continuous improvement across our semiconductor manufacturing operations. The role will be part of the Product Engineering BiMOS organization.

How you'll make an impact

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of Product Engineers, fostering a high-performance culture
• Drive accountability and support employees in reaching their full potential through clear expectations, regular feedback, and professional development
• Lead yield improvement, quality enhancement, and cost optimization activities
• Ensure end-to-end product ownership covering quality, reliability, manufacturability, and product performance
• Collaborate closely with R&D, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, and Product Management
• Support industrialization and transfer of new technologies and products into high-volume manufacturing
• Prioritize resources, remove obstacles, and ensure effective execution of strategic objectives
• Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence across the organization
Your background

• Master's or Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, Semiconductor Technology, or a related field
• Several years of experience in semiconductor manufacturing, product engineering, process engineering, or quality engineering
• Proven leadership experience with a strong track record of building, motivating, and developing high-performing teams
• Demonstrated ability to address performance gaps and actively bring people to the required performance level through coaching, feedback, and structured development plans
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
• Fluent German and English language skills are mandatory
More about us

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance

Sind Sie eine erfahrene Führungskraft mit einer Leidenschaft für Halbleiterfertigung, Ingenieurwesen und Personalentwicklung? Wir suchen nach einem Team Lead Product Engineering BiMOS, um ein Team von hochqualifizierten Ingenieuren und Technikern zu leiten und technische Exzellenz, Betriebsleistung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung in unseren Halbleiterfertigungsbetrieben voranzutreiben. Die Rolle wird Teil der Product Engineering BiMOS Organisation sein.

Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen werden

• Führen, coachen und entwickeln Sie ein Team von Produktingenieuren, um eine Hochleistungskultur zu fördern
• Förderung der Rechenschaftspflicht und Unterstützung der Mitarbeiter bei der Erreichung ihres vollen Potenzials durch klare Erwartungen, regelmäßiges Feedback und berufliche Entwicklung
• Lead Yield Verbesserung, Qualitätsverbesserung und Kostenoptimierung
• Sicherstellung des End-to-End-Produkteigentums, das Qualität, Zuverlässigkeit, Herstellbarkeit und Produktleistung abdeckt
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit R&D, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality und Product Management
• Unterstützung der Industrialisierung und des Transfers neuer Technologien und Produkte in die Massenfertigung
• Ressourcen priorisieren, Hindernisse beseitigen und eine effektive Umsetzung strategischer Ziele sicherstellen
• Steigern Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserung und operative Exzellenz in der gesamten Organisation
Dein Hintergrund

• Master- oder Bachelor-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, Physik, Materialwissenschaften, Halbleitertechnologie oder einem verwandten Bereich
• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Halbleiterfertigung, Produkttechnik, Verfahrenstechnik oder Qualitätstechnik
• Bewährte Führungserfahrung mit einer starken Erfolgsbilanz beim Aufbau, der Motivation und der Entwicklung leistungsstarker Teams
• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, Leistungslücken zu schließen und Menschen durch Coaching, Feedback und strukturierte Entwicklungspläne aktiv auf das erforderliche Leistungsniveau zu bringen
• Starke analytische, Problemlösungs- und Entscheidungsfähigkeiten
• Exzellentes Stakeholder-Management und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
• Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind Pflicht
Mehr über uns

Wir glauben, dass großartige Arbeit in einem Umfeld gedeiht, in dem sich die Menschen wirklich unterstützt und fair belohnt fühlen. Unsere Vorteile sind so konzipiert, dass sie für jeden Einzelnen einen echten Mehrwert schaffen – und so Engagement, Leistung und Wachstum fördern. Durch die Priorisierung des Wohlbefindens schaffen wir einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem persönlicher und organisatorischer Erfolg zusammenwachsen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'opportunité

Êtes-vous un leader expérimenté avec une passion pour la fabrication de semi-conducteurs, l'ingénierie et le développement humain? Nous sommes à la recherche d'une équipe responsable de l'ingénierie des produits BiMOS pour diriger une équipe d'ingénieurs et de techniciens hautement qualifiés et conduire l'excellence technique, la performance opérationnelle et l'amélioration continue dans nos opérations de fabrication de semi-conducteurs. Le rôle fera partie de l'organisation Product Engineering BiMOS.

Comment vous allez avoir un impact

• Diriger, coacher et développer une équipe d'ingénieurs de produits, favorisant une culture de haute performance
• Favoriser la responsabilisation et aider les employés à réaliser leur plein potentiel grâce à des attentes claires, à une rétroaction régulière et au perfectionnement professionnel
• Amélioration du rendement du plomb, amélioration de la qualité et optimisation des coûts
• Assurer la propriété des produits de bout en bout couvrant la qualité, la fiabilité, la fabrication et les performances des produits
• Collaborer étroitement avec la R-D, les opérations, la chaîne d'approvisionnement, la qualité et la gestion des produits
• Soutenir l'industrialisation et le transfert de nouvelles technologies et de nouveaux produits dans la fabrication en grand volume
• Privilégier les ressources, lever les obstacles et assurer la réalisation effective des objectifs stratégiques
• Favoriser l'amélioration continue et l'excellence opérationnelle dans l'ensemble de l'organisation
Vos antécédents

• Maîtrise ou baccalauréat en génie électrique, physique, sciences des matériaux, technologie semi-conducteur ou domaine connexe
• Plusieurs années d'expérience dans la fabrication de semi-conducteurs, l'ingénierie des produits, l'ingénierie des procédés ou l'ingénierie de la qualité
• Expérience de leadership éprouvée avec une solide expérience de construction, de motivation et de développement d'équipes à haut rendement
• Capacité démontrée de combler les lacunes en matière de rendement et d'amener activement les gens au niveau de rendement requis au moyen de plans d'encadrement, de rétroaction et de perfectionnement structuré
• Fortes compétences en analyse, en résolution de problèmes et en prise de décisions
• Excellentes compétences en gestion des parties prenantes et en communication
• Les compétences en allemand et en anglais sont obligatoires
Plus sur nous

Nous croyons que le grand travail prospère dans un environnement où les gens se sentent véritablement soutenus et équitablement récompensés. Nos avantages sont conçus pour créer une valeur réelle pour chaque individu – alimenter l'engagement, la performance et la croissance. En donnant la priorité au bien-être, nous construisons un milieu de travail où la réussite personnelle et organisationnelle grandit ensemble.

jobs.title: Factory Controller 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

We are looking for a Factory Controller to join the Semiconductors Finance team, supporting manufacturing operations with accurate financial reporting, forecasting, and compliance. In this role, you will be responsible for month-ly closings, budgeting, and continuous improvement of controlling processes, ensuring transparency and efficiency across manufacturing, R&D, and CAPEX activities.

How you'll make an impact

• Monthly closing: ensure accuracy and analysis of manufacturing Cost Centers spending
• Support Head of Finance / Manufacturing leader with spending forecast & variance analysis
• Ensure accuracy of monthly closing R&D and CAPEX related activities
• Ensure accuracy of R&D spending in relevant reporting tools including SAP
• Continuous improvement of controlling and reporting processes
• Lead Annual Budgeting for relevant cost centers
• Ensure compliance with SOX internal controls
• Respond to requests from internal and external auditors
Your background

• Bachelor's degree in finance, preferably with a focus on accounting or controlling
• Minimum of 5 years of experience in accounting and controlling in a manufacturing setting
• Proficient user of SAP
• Prior initial experience in Manufacturing, R&D, and CAPEX controlling
• Basic understanding of project management principles
• Strong analytical skills and communication skills

More about us

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.

jobs.title: Project Manager Structural Engineering 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Hitachi Energy's High Voltage Products business is a global leader in power transmission and distribution. At our Zurich-Oerlikon site, we develop and manufacture gas-insulated switchgear (GIS) that helps deliver reliable electrical energy worldwide.

We are looking for a Project Manager Structural Engineering to join our team. In this role, you will manage technical engineering projects in close collaboration with our project team in the Czech Republic, support projects throughout their lifecycle, and lead technical discussions with internal and external stakeholders.

You bring a degree in Civil Engineering and several years of experience in structural engineering, steel construction, or a related field. You enjoy working in an international environment, coordinating multidisciplinary teams, and driving projects forward with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.

If you're excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply, even if your experience doesn't perfectly match every requirement.

How you'll make an impact

• Manage structural engineering projects throughout the entire lifecycle, from sales support and design to fabrication and on-site installation
• Take technical and commercial responsibility for project execution, ensuring compliance with standards, timelines, costs, and quality targets
• Collaborate closely with sales, project management, engineering teams, and customers to define project requirements and deliver effective solutions
• Act as the interface between GIS project engineering and structural engineering, ensuring smooth coordination across disciplines
• Lead and coordinate engineering activities with teams in Brno (Czech Republic), Chennai (India), and external partners
• Initiate and oversee supply chain activities related to the procurement and fabrication of steel structures and platforms
• Ensure high-quality project delivery by reviewing engineering deliverables, resolving technical and quality issues, and supporting factories and site teams
• Drive continuous improvement by sharing lessons learned, supporting root cause analysis, and implementing sustainable solutions to enhance future project execution
 Your background

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Civil Engineering or a related field
• 3+ years of experience in technical project management within civil engineering, ideally in steel structures, industrial plants, substations, or energy infrastructure
• Experience with GIS projects or substation engineering is a strong advantage
• Proficiency in CAD tools (2D and 3D AutoCAD); experience with BIM software such as Tekla Structures is beneficial
• Understanding of structural design standards and building codes (e.g., Eurocodes, AISC, EN 1090); experience with structural analysis software such as SCIA Engineer or STAAD.Pro is a plus
• Experience working with SAP or similar ERP systems is advantageous
• Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in international and cross-functional teams
• Professional proficiency in English; German or additional languages are considered an advantage
More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Il business dei prodotti ad alta tensione di Hitachi Energy è un leader globale nella trasmissione e distribuzione di energia. Nel nostro sito di Zurigo-Oerlikon, sviluppiamo e produciamo interruttori isolati a gas (GIS) che aiutano a fornire energia elettrica affidabile in tutto il mondo.

Stiamo cercando un Project Manager Ingegneria Strutturale per unirsi al nostro team. In questo ruolo, gestirete i progetti di ingegneria tecnica in stretta collaborazione con il nostro team di progetto nella Repubblica Ceca, sostenere i progetti in tutto il loro ciclo di vita e condurre discussioni tecniche con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni.

Si porta una laurea in Ingegneria Civile e diversi anni di esperienza in ingegneria strutturale, costruzione di acciaio, o un campo correlato. Ti piace lavorare in un ambiente internazionale, coordinare team multidisciplinari e portare avanti progetti con una mentalità proattiva e orientata alla soluzione.

Se siete entusiasti di questa opportunità, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare, anche se la vostra esperienza non corrisponde perfettamente a ogni esigenza.

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Gestire progetti di ingegneria strutturale in tutto il ciclo di vita, dal supporto di vendita e progettazione alla fabbricazione e installazione in loco
• Assumere la responsabilità tecnica e commerciale per l'esecuzione del progetto, garantendo il rispetto di standard, tempi, costi e obiettivi di qualità
• Collabora a stretto contatto con vendite, project management, team di ingegneria e clienti per definire i requisiti del progetto e fornire soluzioni efficaci
• Agire come interfaccia tra l'ingegneria del progetto GIS e l'ingegneria strutturale, garantendo un coordinamento regolare tra le discipline
• Leader e coordinare le attività di ingegneria con i team di Brno (Repubblica Ceca), Chennai (India) e partner esterni
• Iniziare e supervisionare le attività della supply chain relative all'approvvigionamento e alla fabbricazione di strutture e piattaforme in acciaio
• Assicurare la consegna di progetti di alta qualità rivedendo i materiali di ingegneria, risolvendo problemi tecnici e di qualità, e supportando fabbriche e team di siti
• Promuovere un miglioramento continuo condividendo lezioni apprese, supportando l'analisi delle cause e implementando soluzioni sostenibili per migliorare l'esecuzione del progetto futuro
Il tuo sfondo

• Bachelor o Master in Ingegneria Civile o un campo correlato
• 3+ anni di esperienza nella gestione dei progetti tecnici all'interno dell'ingegneria civile, idealmente nelle strutture siderurgiche, negli impianti industriali, nelle sottostazioni o nell'infrastruttura energetica
• L'esperienza con i progetti GIS o l'ingegneria sottostazione è un forte vantaggio
• La competenza negli strumenti CAD (2D e 3D AutoCAD); l'esperienza con software BIM come Tekla Structures è utile
• Comprensione degli standard di progettazione strutturale e dei codici di costruzione (ad esempio Eurocodes, AISC, EN 1090); esperienza con software di analisi strutturale come SCIA Engineer o STAAD. Pro è un plus
• L'esperienza di lavoro con SAP o simili sistemi ERP è vantaggiosa
• Forte comunicazione e capacità organizzative, con la capacità di collaborare efficacemente in team internazionali e interfunzionali
• La competenza professionale in inglese; le lingue tedesche o aggiuntive sono considerate un vantaggio
Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

jobs.title: Project Manager Structural Engineering 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Hitachi Energy's High Voltage Products business is a global leader in power transmission and distribution. At our Zurich-Oerlikon site, we develop and manufacture gas-insulated switchgear (GIS) that helps deliver reliable electrical energy worldwide.

We are looking for a Project Manager Structural Engineering to join our team. In this role, you will manage technical engineering projects in close collaboration with our project team in the Czech Republic, support projects throughout their lifecycle, and lead technical discussions with internal and external stakeholders.

You bring a degree in Civil Engineering and several years of experience in structural engineering, steel construction, or a related field. You enjoy working in an international environment, coordinating multidisciplinary teams, and driving projects forward with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.

If you're excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply, even if your experience doesn't perfectly match every requirement.

How you'll make an impact

• Manage structural engineering projects throughout the entire lifecycle, from sales support and design to fabrication and on-site installation
• Take technical and commercial responsibility for project execution, ensuring compliance with standards, timelines, costs, and quality targets
• Collaborate closely with sales, project management, engineering teams, and customers to define project requirements and deliver effective solutions
• Act as the interface between GIS project engineering and structural engineering, ensuring smooth coordination across disciplines
• Lead and coordinate engineering activities with teams in Brno (Czech Republic), Chennai (India), and external partners
• Initiate and oversee supply chain activities related to the procurement and fabrication of steel structures and platforms
• Ensure high-quality project delivery by reviewing engineering deliverables, resolving technical and quality issues, and supporting factories and site teams
• Drive continuous improvement by sharing lessons learned, supporting root cause analysis, and implementing sustainable solutions to enhance future project execution
 Your background

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Civil Engineering or a related field
• 3+ years of experience in technical project management within civil engineering, ideally in steel structures, industrial plants, substations, or energy infrastructure
• Experience with GIS projects or substation engineering is a strong advantage
• Proficiency in CAD tools (2D and 3D AutoCAD); experience with BIM software such as Tekla Structures is beneficial
• Understanding of structural design standards and building codes (e.g., Eurocodes, AISC, EN 1090); experience with structural analysis software such as SCIA Engineer or STAAD.Pro is a plus
• Experience working with SAP or similar ERP systems is advantageous
• Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in international and cross-functional teams
• Professional proficiency in English; German or additional languages are considered an advantage
More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Outbound Logistics Team Leader 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Hitachi Energy is looking for an experienced Outbound Logistics Team Leader to coordinate and continuously improve outbound logistics activities for our GIS business.

In this role, you will combine operational involvement with people leadership, helping to ensure products are delivered to customers around the world safely, efficiently, and on time. Working closely with colleagues across multiple functions and with external logistics partners, you will contribute to smooth day-to-day operations while supporting ongoing improvements in processes, customer experience, and team performance. Join our team!

How you'll make an impact

• Promote a strong safety culture across all logistics activities, ensuring compliance with workplace health and safety requirements and proactively addressing potential risks
• Coordinate and support daily outbound logistics operations, helping to ensure timely and efficient delivery of products to customers
• Guide, coach, and support a team of logistics specialists, fostering collaboration, development, and knowledge sharing
• Monitor transportation, warehousing, and distribution activities, addressing operational challenges and supporting effective solutions
• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, service quality, and overall logistics performance
• Partner with colleagues in manufacturing, project management, procurement, customer service, and external logistics providers to ensure smooth order fulfillment
• Support the management of carriers and logistics service providers, including performance monitoring and issue resolution
• Monitor and analyze logistics KPIs, prepare operational reports, and help identify opportunities for improvement across the outbound process
• Promote compliance with packaging regulations, customs requirements, and company policies, as well as help create a positive, inclusive, and customer-focused team environment
Your background

• Degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field, combined with strong experience in logistics, supply chain, or transportation operations. Experience coordinating or leading teams is essential
• Experience managing outbound logistics activities in an international environment
• Experience working with ERP systems, logistics management systems, and reporting tools
• Strong problem-solving skills and a practical approach to operational challenge
• Effective communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build positive working relationships across teams
• Experience supporting, motivating, and developing others in a collaborative environment
• Fluency in English and German
More about us

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.

• Contribuisci a iniziative di miglioramento continuo che migliorano l'efficienza, la qualità dei servizi e le prestazioni logistiche globali
• Partner con i colleghi nella produzione, nella gestione dei progetti, nell'approvvigionamento, nel servizio clienti e nei fornitori di logistica esterni per garantire un corretto adempimento degli ordini

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

descriptionByLocale.en:

Hitachi Energy is looking for an experienced Outbound Logistics Team Leader to coordinate and continuously improve outbound logistics activities for our GIS business.

In this role, you will combine operational involvement with people leadership, helping to ensure products are delivered to customers around the world safely, efficiently, and on time. Working closely with colleagues across multiple functions and with external logistics partners, you will contribute to smooth day-to-day operations while supporting ongoing improvements in processes, customer experience, and team performance. Join our team!

How you'll make an impact

• Promote a strong safety culture across all logistics activities, ensuring compliance with workplace health and safety requirements and proactively addressing potential risks
• Coordinate and support daily outbound logistics operations, helping to ensure timely and efficient delivery of products to customers
• Guide, coach, and support a team of logistics specialists, fostering collaboration, development, and knowledge sharing

descriptionByLocale.de:

• Erleben Sie Unterstützung, Motivation und Entwicklung anderer in einer kollaborativen Umgebung
• Fließend in Englisch und Deutsch
Mehr über uns

Wir glauben, dass großartige Arbeit in einem Umfeld gedeiht, in dem sich die Menschen wirklich unterstützt und fair belohnt fühlen. Unsere Vorteile sind so konzipiert, dass sie für jeden Einzelnen einen echten Mehrwert schaffen – und so Engagement, Leistung und Wachstum fördern. Durch die Priorisierung des Wohlbefindens schaffen wir einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem persönlicher und organisatorischer Erfolg zusammenwachsen.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Tendering Specialist – Substation Automation 80-100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity
As a Senior Technical Tendering Specialist, you will play a key role in shaping the future of the energy transition by leading the technical bid preparation for some of our most strategic and complex opportunities within the Renewables and Offshore Business.

In this role, you will drive the development of competitive and technically sound proposals for large-scale renewable, offshore wind, grid integration, and AC substation projects. Acting as a technical authority throughout the tendering process, you will collaborate with global cross-functional teams, manage technical risks, and help secure profitable business growth in a dynamic international environment.
If you enjoy solving complex challenges, influencing key business decisions, and working on projects that contribute to a sustainable energy future, we would love to hear from you.

How you'll make an impact

• Lead technical tendering activities for large-scale, high-value, and strategically important opportunities within the Renewable and Offshore AC market
• Prepare competitive and technically optimized system proposals, including solution design, cost estimation, and supplier quotation evaluations
• Define technical scope, identify project risks and opportunities, and support the development of winning bid strategies
• Coordinate and drive internal tender reviews, risk assessments, and approval processes in alignment with company governance requirements
• Ensure the delivery of high-quality, compliant, and competitive proposals within agreed timelines
• Act as a technical advisor to Sales and Business Development teams during customer discussions and bid negotiations
• Collaborate with engineering, project management, supply chain, and commercial teams to develop optimized customer solutions
• Evaluate supplier and subcontractor offerings, ensuring alignment with technical specifications and project requirements
• Lead and coordinate global, multidisciplinary proposal teams across multiple locations and business units
• Support the continuous improvement of tendering processes, tools, and best practices across the organization
• Mentor and support junior tendering professionals to strengthen organizational capabilities and knowledge sharing
Your background

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline, preferably with a focus on power systems or power engineering
• Minimum 5 years of experience in project execution, engineering, system design, lead engineering, commissioning, or a comparable technical role within substation automation, protection, and control systems
• Ideally 2+ years of experience in bid management, proposal engineering, tendering, sales support, or a customer-facing technical role
• Strong understanding of substation automation, protection and control systems, and AC substation applications
• Experience working with complex customer specifications, contractual requirements, and technical risk assessments
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment
• Ability to lead and influence cross-functional and virtual teams without direct reporting responsibility
• Structured, proactive, and detail-oriented working style
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and MS Visio
• Willingness to travel internationally up to approximately 10%
• Excellent communication skills in English; additional European language skills are considered an advantage
More about us
At Hitachi Energy, we are advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We serve customers in the utility, industry, transportation, data center, and infrastructure sectors with innovative solutions and services across the value chain. Together with customers and partners, we pioneer technologies and enable the digital transformation required to accelerate the energy transition.

Join us and be part of a team committed to making the world's energy system more sustainable, flexible, and secure.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità
In qualità di Senior Technical Tendering Specialist, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella definizione del futuro della transizione energetica, guidando la preparazione dell'offerta tecnica per alcune delle nostre opportunità più strategiche e complesse all'interno del Renewables e Offshore Business.

In questo ruolo, guiderai lo sviluppo di proposte competitive e tecnicamente valide per progetti di sottostazione AC, rinnovabili e offshore. Essendo un'autorità tecnica in tutto il processo di appalto, collaborerai con team multifunzionali globali, gestirai i rischi tecnici e ti aiuterai a garantire una crescita economica redditizia in un ambiente dinamico internazionale.
Se ti piace risolvere sfide complesse, influenzare le decisioni aziendali chiave, e lavorare su progetti che contribuiscono a un futuro energetico sostenibile, ci piacerebbe sentire da te.

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Condurre attività di tendering tecnico per grandi, ad alto valore e opportunità strategicamente importanti nel mercato AC Rinnovabile e Offshore
• Preparare proposte di sistema competitive e tecnicamente ottimizzate, tra cui progettazione di soluzioni, stima dei costi e valutazioni delle quote dei fornitori
• Definire lo scopo tecnico, identificare i rischi e le opportunità del progetto e sostenere lo sviluppo di strategie di offerta vincenti
• Coordinare e guidare le recensioni dei bandi di gara interne, le valutazioni dei rischi e i processi di approvazione in linea con i requisiti di governance aziendale
• Garantire la consegna di proposte di alta qualità, conformi e competitive entro tempi concordati
• Atto come consulente tecnico per i team di Sales and Business Development durante le discussioni e le trattative sulle offerte dei clienti
• Collabora con team di ingegneria, project management, supply chain e commerciali per sviluppare soluzioni clienti ottimizzate
• Valutare le offerte di fornitori e subappaltatori, garantendo l'allineamento con le specifiche tecniche e i requisiti di progetto
• Leader e coordinare team di proposte globali e multidisciplinari in più sedi e business unit
• Sostenere il continuo miglioramento dei processi di tendering, degli strumenti e delle migliori pratiche in tutta l'organizzazione
• Mentore e supporto giovani professionisti dell'offerta per rafforzare le capacità organizzative e la condivisione delle conoscenze
Il tuo sfondo

• Corso di laurea o master in ingegneria elettrica o una disciplina correlata, preferibilmente con un focus sui sistemi di potenza o ingegneria
• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nell'esecuzione del progetto, nell'ingegneria, nella progettazione del sistema, nell'ingegneria del piombo, nella messa in servizio o in un ruolo tecnico paragonabile all'interno di sistemi di automazione, protezione e controllo di sottostazione
• Idealmente 2+ anni di esperienza nella gestione delle offerte, nell'ingegneria delle proposte, nell'offerta, nel supporto alle vendite o in un ruolo tecnico rivolto al cliente
• Forte comprensione dei sistemi di automazione, protezione e controllo di sottostazione e delle applicazioni di sottostazione AC
• Esperienza di lavoro con complesse specifiche dei clienti, requisiti contrattuali e valutazioni di rischio tecnico
• Forte capacità analitiche e problem solving con la capacità di gestire più priorità in un ambiente dinamico
• Capacità di guidare e influenzare le squadre interfunzionali e virtuali senza responsabilità di reporting diretto
• Stile di lavoro strutturato, proattivo e dettagliato
• Proficienza in Microsoft Office e MS Visio
• Volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale fino a circa il 10%
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione in inglese; ulteriori competenze linguistiche europee sono considerate un vantaggio
Ulteriori informazioni su di noi
In Hitachi Energy, stiamo promuovendo un futuro energetico sostenibile per tutti. Serviamo i clienti nei settori di utilità, industria, trasporto, data center e infrastrutture con soluzioni e servizi innovativi in tutta la catena del valore. Insieme a clienti e partner, pionieri delle tecnologie e consentiamo la trasformazione digitale necessaria per accelerare la transizione energetica.

Unisciti a noi e fai parte di un team impegnato a rendere il sistema energetico mondiale più sostenibile, flessibile e sicuro.

Als Senior Technical Tendering Specialist werden Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung der Zukunft der Energiewende spielen, indem Sie die technische Angebotsvorbereitung für einige unserer strategischsten und komplexesten Möglichkeiten im Erneuerbaren- und Offshore-Geschäft leiten.

En tant que spécialiste principal de l'appel d'offres technique, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la façon de façonner l'avenir de la transition énergétique en dirigeant la préparation des soumissions techniques pour certaines de nos opportunités les plus stratégiques et complexes au sein de l'entreprise renouvelable et offshore.

Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez l'élaboration de propositions compétitives et techniquement solides pour des projets à grande échelle d'énergie renouvelable, d'énergie éolienne offshore, d'intégration du réseau et de sous-stations AC.
