jobs.title: Senior System Engineer (SCADA/RTU) for Substation Automation 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Our Grid Automation business unit has a comprehensive portfolio of solutions. These range from substation automation, communication networks, grid automation services, grid edge solutions to enterprise software solutions. These solutions address all key segments connected to the energy system including generation, transmission distribution, industries, transportation, and infrastructure sectors.

To strengthen our Engineering team, we are looking for an experienced Senior System Engineer (SCADA) to support challenging projects in the field of substation automation for high- and medium-voltage installations. In this key role, you will combine strong technical expertise with project responsibility and a customer-focused mindset. You will develop innovative automation solutions, coordinate technical interfaces, and support projects from the concept phase through engineering and testing to successful commissioning. If you are looking to contribute your experience in an international environment and help shape the future of intelligent power grids, we look forward to receiving your application.

Your responsibilities

• Design and implement SCADA systems for high- and medium-voltage substations based on IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104/-101/-103, Modbus, DNP, OPC, and other relevant communication protocols
• Develop system and network architectures and integrate RTU, gateway, protection, and automation systems into complex plant environments
• Configure and parameterize Ethernet-based communication networks and implement project-specific functionalities and software applications
• Execute system, integration, and Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) to ensure the highest level of system quality
• Support commissioning activities and service interventions at customer sites, primarily within Switzerland, including troubleshooting and resolving complex technical issues
• Take technical ownership within projects and advise customers on optimal automation and communication solutions
• Collaborate closely with project management, sales, suppliers, and internal engineering teams to ensure successful project execution
• Prepare technical specifications, system and network concepts, test documentation, as well as operation and training manuals
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering standards, processes, and best practices in the field of substation automation
Your background

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a comparable technical qualification
• Min 5 years of experience in power automation, substation automation, SCADA, or RTU systems
• Strong knowledge of industrial communication protocols, network architectures, and cybersecurity within critical infrastructure environments
• Experience with IEC 61850-based systems and the integration of protection, control, and automation systems
• Knowledge of MicroSCADA, RTU500, or IET600 is considered an advantage
• Experience in technical project coordination, customer consulting, Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), commissioning, and/or customer training
• Independent, structured, and solution-oriented working style with strong communication, coordination, and troubleshooting skills
• Excellent English language skills, both written and spoken. German language skills are an advantage but not required
• Additional languages are welcome
More about us

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Il nostro business unit Grid Automation ha un portafoglio completo di soluzioni. Questi spaziano dall'automazione della sottostazione, dalle reti di comunicazione, dai servizi di automazione della griglia, dalle soluzioni di bordo della griglia alle soluzioni software aziendali. Queste soluzioni affrontano tutti i segmenti chiave collegati al sistema energetico, tra cui la generazione, la distribuzione della trasmissione, le industrie, i trasporti e i settori delle infrastrutture.

Per rafforzare il nostro team Engineering, stiamo cercando un esperto Senior System Engineer (SCADA) per sostenere progetti impegnativi nel campo dell'automazione delle sottostazione per installazioni ad alta e media tensione. In questo ruolo chiave, unirete forti competenze tecniche con la responsabilità del progetto e una mentalità focalizzata sul cliente. Svilupperai soluzioni di automazione innovative, coordini interfacce tecniche e supporti progetti dalla fase concept attraverso l'ingegneria e il test per la messa in servizio di successo. Se state cercando di contribuire alla vostra esperienza in un ambiente internazionale e contribuire a plasmare il futuro delle reti di energia intelligenti, non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione.

Le tue responsabilità

• Progettazione e realizzazione di sistemi SCADA per sottostazioni ad alta e media tensione basate su IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104/-101/-103, Modbus, DNP, OPC e altri protocolli di comunicazione pertinenti
• Sviluppare architetture di sistema e di rete e integrare sistemi RTU, gateway, protezione e automazione in ambienti complessi
• Configurare e parametrizzare le reti di comunicazione basate su Ethernet e implementare funzionalità e applicazioni software specifiche per progetti
• Eseguire il sistema, l'integrazione e i test di accettazione della fabbrica (FAT) per garantire il massimo livello di qualità del sistema
• Sostenere le attività di messa in servizio e gli interventi di assistenza presso i siti dei clienti, principalmente in Svizzera, tra cui la risoluzione dei problemi e la risoluzione di problemi tecnici complessi
• Prendere la proprietà tecnica all'interno di progetti e consigliare i clienti su soluzioni di automazione e comunicazione ottimali
• Collabora a stretto contatto con i team di project management, vendita, fornitori e ingegneria interna per garantire l'esecuzione di progetti di successo
• Preparare le specifiche tecniche, i concetti di sistema e di rete, la documentazione di prova, nonché i manuali di funzionamento e formazione
• Contribuire al miglioramento continuo delle norme di ingegneria, dei processi e delle migliori pratiche nel campo dell'automazione di sottostazione
Il tuo sfondo

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

Our Grid Automation business unit has a comprehensive portfolio of solutions. These range from substation automation, communication networks, grid automation services, grid edge solutions to enterprise software solutions. These solutions address all key segments connected to the energy system including generation, transmission distribution, industries, transportation, and infrastructure sectors.

To strengthen our Engineering team, we are looking for an experienced Senior System Engineer (SCADA) to support challenging projects in the field of substation automation for high- and medium-voltage installations. In this key role, you will combine strong technical expertise with project responsibility and a customer-focused mindset. You will develop innovative automation solutions, coordinate technical interfaces, and support projects from the concept phase through engineering and testing to successful commissioning. If you are looking to contribute your experience in an international environment and help shape the future of intelligent power grids, we look forward to receiving your application.

Your responsibilities

• Design and implement SCADA systems for high- and medium-voltage substations based on IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104/-101/-103, Modbus, DNP, OPC, and other relevant communication protocols
• Develop system and network architectures and integrate RTU, gateway, protection, and automation systems into complex plant environments
• Configure and parameterize Ethernet-based communication networks and implement project-specific functionalities and software applications
• Execute system, integration, and Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) to ensure the highest level of system quality
• Support commissioning activities and service interventions at customer sites, primarily within Switzerland, including troubleshooting and resolving complex technical issues
• Take technical ownership within projects and advise customers on optimal automation and communication solutions
• Collaborate closely with project management, sales, suppliers, and internal engineering teams to ensure successful project execution
• Prepare technical specifications, system and network concepts, test documentation, as well as operation and training manuals
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering standards, processes, and best practices in the field of substation automation
Your background

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a comparable technical qualification
• Min 5 years of experience in power automation, substation automation, SCADA, or RTU systems
• Strong knowledge of industrial communication protocols, network architectures, and cybersecurity within critical infrastructure environments
• Experience with IEC 61850-based systems and the integration of protection, control, and automation systems
• Knowledge of MicroSCADA, RTU500, or IET600 is considered an advantage
• Experience in technical project coordination, customer consulting, Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), commissioning, and/or customer training
• Independent, structured, and solution-oriented working style with strong communication, coordination, and troubleshooting skills
• Excellent English language skills, both written and spoken. German language skills are an advantage but not required
• Additional languages are welcome
More about us

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance

Unsere Geschäftseinheit Grid Automation verfügt über ein umfassendes Lösungsportfolio. Diese reichen von der Automatisierung von Umspannstationen, Kommunikationsnetzwerken, Netzautomatisierungsdiensten, Netzrandlösungen bis hin zu Unternehmenssoftwarelösungen. Diese Lösungen richten sich an alle wichtigen Segmente, die mit dem Energiesystem verbunden sind, einschließlich Erzeugung, Übertragungsverteilung, Industrie, Verkehr und Infrastruktursektoren.

Um unser Engineering-Team zu stärken, suchen wir einen erfahrenen Senior System Engineer (SCADA), der anspruchsvolle Projekte im Bereich der Umspannwerksautomatisierung für Hoch- und Mittelspannungsinstallationen unterstützt. In dieser Schlüsselrolle verbinden Sie starkes technisches Know-how mit Projektverantwortung und einer kundenorientierten Denkweise. Sie entwickeln innovative Automatisierungslösungen, koordinieren technische Schnittstellen und unterstützen Projekte von der Konzeptphase über Engineering und Testing bis hin zur erfolgreichen Inbetriebnahme. Wenn Sie Ihre Erfahrungen in einem internationalen Umfeld einbringen und die Zukunft intelligenter Stromnetze mitgestalten möchten, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

Ihre Verantwortung

• Entwurf und Implementierung von SCADA-Systemen für Hoch- und Mittelspannungs-Umspannstationen auf Basis von IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104/-101/-103, Modbus, DNP, OPC und anderen relevanten Kommunikationsprotokollen
• System- und Netzwerkarchitekturen entwickeln und RTU-, Gateway-, Schutz- und Automatisierungssysteme in komplexe Anlagenumgebungen integrieren
• Konfigurieren und Parametrieren von Ethernet-basierten Kommunikationsnetzwerken und Implementieren von projektspezifischen Funktionalitäten und Softwareanwendungen
• Ausführen von System-, Integrations- und Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), um die höchste Systemqualität zu gewährleisten
• Unterstützung von Inbetriebnahmeaktivitäten und Serviceinterventionen bei Kunden vor allem in der Schweiz, einschließlich der Fehlersuche und Lösung komplexer technischer Probleme
• Übernehmen Sie technische Verantwortung innerhalb von Projekten und beraten Sie Kunden zu optimalen Automatisierungs- und Kommunikationslösungen
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Projektmanagement, Vertrieb, Lieferanten und internen Engineering-Teams, um eine erfolgreiche Projektabwicklung sicherzustellen
• Bereiten Sie technische Spezifikationen, System- und Netzwerkkonzepte, Testdokumentation sowie Betriebs- und Schulungshandbücher vor
• Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Engineering-Standards, Prozessen und Best Practices im Bereich der Umspannwerksautomatisierung
Dein Hintergrund

• Bachelor- oder Masterstudium Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik, Automatisierungstechnik oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation
• Min 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Energieautomation, Umspannwerksautomation, SCADA oder RTU Systemen
• Umfangreiche Kenntnisse über industrielle Kommunikationsprotokolle, Netzwerkarchitekturen und Cybersicherheit in kritischen Infrastrukturumgebungen
• Erfahrung mit IEC 61850-basierten Systemen und der Integration von Schutz-, Steuerungs- und Automatisierungssystemen
• Kenntnisse von MicroSCADA, RTU500 oder IET600 gelten als Vorteil
• Erfahrung in technischer Projektkoordination, Kundenberatung, Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), Inbetriebnahme und/oder Kundenschulung
• Unabhängiger, strukturierter und lösungsorientierter Arbeitsstil mit starken Kommunikations-, Koordinations- und Fehlerbehebungsfähigkeiten
• Hervorragende Englischkenntnisse, sowohl geschrieben als auch gesprochen. Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil, aber nicht erforderlich
• Weitere Sprachen sind willkommen
Mehr über uns

Wir glauben, dass großartige Arbeit in einem Umfeld gedeiht, in dem sich die Menschen wirklich unterstützt und fair belohnt fühlen. descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'opportunité

Notre unité commerciale Grid Automation dispose d'un portefeuille complet de solutions. Ceux-ci vont de l'automatisation des sous-stations, des réseaux de communication, des services d'automatisation de réseau, des solutions de bord de réseau aux solutions logicielles d'entreprise. Ces solutions couvrent tous les segments clés liés au système énergétique, y compris les secteurs de la production, de la distribution de transport, des industries, des transports et de l'infrastructure.

Pour renforcer notre équipe d'ingénierie, nous recherchons un ingénieur système senior expérimenté (SCADA) pour soutenir des projets difficiles dans le domaine de l'automatisation des sous-stations pour les installations à haute et moyenne tension. Dans ce rôle clé, vous combinerez une solide expertise technique avec la responsabilité du projet et un état d'esprit axé sur le client. Vous développerez des solutions d'automatisation innovantes, coordonnerez les interfaces techniques et accompagnerez les projets depuis la phase de concept jusqu'à la mise en service réussie. Si vous souhaitez apporter votre expérience dans un environnement international et contribuer à façonner l'avenir des réseaux électriques intelligents, nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre application.

Vos responsabilités

• Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des systèmes SCADA pour les sous-stations à haute et moyenne tension basées sur les protocoles IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104/-101/-103, Modbus, DNP, OPC et autres protocoles de communication pertinents
• Développer des architectures de systèmes et de réseaux et intégrer les systèmes RTU, passerelle, protection et automatisation dans des environnements complexes
• Configurer et paramétrer les réseaux de communication Ethernet et mettre en œuvre des fonctionnalités et des applications logicielles spécifiques au projet
• Exécuter le système, l'intégration et les tests d'acceptation d'usine (FAT) pour assurer le plus haut niveau de qualité du système
• Soutenir les activités de mise en service et les interventions de service sur les sites clients, principalement en Suisse, y compris le dépannage et la résolution de problèmes techniques complexes
• Prendre en main les projets et conseiller les clients sur des solutions d'automatisation et de communication optimales
• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de gestion de projet, de vente, de fournisseurs et d'ingénierie interne pour assurer le succès de l'exécution du projet
• Préparer les spécifications techniques, les concepts de système et de réseau, la documentation d'essai, ainsi que les manuels d'exploitation et de formation
• Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des normes techniques, des processus et des meilleures pratiques dans le domaine de l'automatisation des sous-stations
Vos antécédents

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie électrique, génie de l'électricité, génie de l'automatisation ou une qualification technique comparable
• Mini 5 ans d'expérience dans l'automatisation de l'électricité, l'automatisation des sous-stations, la SCADA ou les systèmes RTU
• Forte connaissance des protocoles de communication industrielle, des architectures de réseau et de la cybersécurité dans les environnements d'infrastructure critiques
• Expérience des systèmes basés sur IEC 61850 et intégration des systèmes de protection, de contrôle et d'automatisation
• La connaissance de MicroSCADA, RTU500 ou IET600 est considérée comme un avantage
• Expérience de la coordination technique des projets, du conseil à la clientèle, des tests d'acceptation en usine, de la mise en service et/ou de la formation à la clientèle
• Style de travail indépendant, structuré et axé sur les solutions, avec de solides compétences en communication, coordination et dépannage
• Excellentes compétences en anglais, à la fois écrites et parlées. Les compétences linguistiques en allemand sont un avantage mais ne sont pas requises
• D'autres langues sont les bienvenues
Plus sur nous

Nous croyons que le grand travail prospère dans un environnement où les gens se sentent véritablement soutenus et équitablement récompensés. Nos avantages sont conçus pour créer une valeur réelle pour chaque individu – alimenter l'engagement, la performance et la croissance. En priorisant le bien-être, nous construisons un milieu de travail où la réussite personnelle et organisationnelle grandit ensemble.

jobs.title: Project Manager GIS High Voltage 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

At Hitachi Energy, you'll have the opportunity to lead complex and meaningful GIS projects that support the energy transition around the world. As a Project Manager, you will work with diverse international teams, customers, and stakeholders to deliver innovative solutions that make a real impact.

We are looking for a collaborative and proactive leader who enjoys bringing people together, solving challenges, and driving successful project outcomes. Whether your experience comes from GIS, substations, power infrastructure, or a related industrial environment, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives, leadership potential, and a growth mindset just as much as specific industry experience.

How you'll make an impact

• Lead complex international projects throughout the entire project lifecycle, from project handover through engineering, manufacturing, installation, commissioning, and final delivery

• Take ownership of project execution, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards

• Build trusted partnerships with customers and serve as their primary point of contact throughout project delivery

• Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams across engineering, operations, supply chain, and service functions worldwide

• Foster strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to drive alignment and project success

• Proactively identify risks, opportunities, and improvement initiatives while guiding the team through challenges and change

• Manage commercial aspects of projects, including contracts, claims, forecasting, and financial performance

• Support continuous improvement efforts and contribute to knowledge sharing, mentoring, and the development of project management excellence within the organization

Your background

• Master's degree in electrical engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field

• Several years of experience driving complex international projects in a global industrial environment

• Experience within GIS, substations, power transmission, energy infrastructure, or similar industries is highly valued

• Being able to drive project delivery, stakeholder management, and customer engagement

• Business and financial acumen with experience managing budgets, schedules, risks, and contracts

• Ability to lead cross-functional teams and successfully navigate complex, multicultural project environments

• Project Management certification (PMP, IPMA, or equivalent) is an advantage but not essential

• Fluent in English, additional languages such as French, Italian or German are a plus

• An organized, resilient, and solution-oriented mindset with a passion for collaboration and delivering value to customers

We know that no candidate meets every qualification listed above. If you're excited about this opportunity and believe your experience can contribute to our success, we encourage you to apply. We welcome diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Siamo alla ricerca di un leader collaborativo e proattivo che si diverte a riunire le persone, risolvere le sfide e guidare risultati di successo del progetto. Se la vostra esperienza proviene da GIS, sottostazioni, infrastrutture di potenza o un ambiente industriale correlato, vi invitiamo a applicare. Valoriamo prospettive diverse, potenziale di leadership e una mentalità di crescita tanto quanto esperienza specifica del settore.

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Leader complessi progetti internazionali in tutto il ciclo di vita del progetto, dalla consegna del progetto attraverso ingegneria, produzione, installazione, messa in servizio e consegna finale

• Assumere la proprietà dell'esecuzione del progetto, garantire che i progetti vengano consegnati in modo sicuro, puntuale, all'interno del budget, e ai più elevati standard di qualità

• Costruire partnership affidabili con i clienti e servire come punto di contatto principale durante la consegna del progetto

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con team multidisciplinari attraverso funzioni di ingegneria, operazioni, supply chain e servizi in tutto il mondo

• Promuovere forti relazioni con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni per guidare l'allineamento e il successo del progetto

• Identificare attivamente rischi, opportunità e iniziative di miglioramento guidando il team attraverso sfide e cambiamenti

• Gestire gli aspetti commerciali dei progetti, inclusi contratti, reclami, previsioni e performance finanziarie

Il tuo sfondo

• Capacità di guidare team interfunzionali e navigare con successo in ambienti di progetto complessi e multiculturali

• La certificazione Project Management (PMP, IPMA o equivalente) è un vantaggio ma non essenziale

Sappiamo che nessun candidato soddisfa tutte le qualifiche sopra elencate. Se sei entusiasta di questa opportunità e credi che la tua esperienza possa contribuire al nostro successo, ti invitiamo a candidarti. Accogliamo sfondi, prospettive e esperienze diverse, e ci impegniamo a creare un posto di lavoro inclusivo dove tutti possono prosperare.

• Erfahrung in GIS, Umspannwerken, Energieübertragung, Energieinfrastruktur oder ähnlichen Branchen wird hoch geschätzt

jobs.title: Internship in Material Science and Varistors 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Join our Profit Center Surge Arresters in Wettingen, Switzerland, where we develop innovative and secure overvoltage protection solutions for power generation, distribution, railway, and industry. You'll be part of a passionate team striving to lead in technology and customer satisfaction. This internship of at least 6 months offers hands-on experience in materials research and process development. You'll contribute to impactful projects while learning from experts in a collaborative and supportive environment.

How you'll make an impact

• Support research on metal oxide varistor materials and manufacturing processes

• Analyze samples using advanced characterization techniques

• Explore links between process parameters, microstructure, and material properties

• Document findings and present results to the research team

• Conduct literature reviews to support ongoing research

jobs.description:
The opportunity

As Global HR Business Partner for our GPG Semiconductor business, you will be supporting a global organization across Switzerland, the Czech Republic, China, India, and the Philippines. This role sits within our Grid Integration Business Unit and you will be a member of both the Semiconductor Management Team and the wider Grid Integration HR Leadership Team.

This opportunity allows you to partner directly with the Global Business Group Leader to drive business growth, leadership development, organizational effectiveness, and talent outcomes.

The role offers a unique combination of strategic influence and operational impact, supporting a diverse workforce spanning manufacturing, R&D, engineering, supply chain, sales, and corporate functions. You will lead, coach and mentor a small team of direct and indirect reports.

For this highly visible HR leadership role, we are looking for an experienced HR professional that has ideally worked within complex manufacturing or industrial environments and has a strong track record in transformation and organizational development, and the ability to influence at all levels, from the shop floor to the executive team.

Our roles at Hitachi Energy are as hands on, as they are strategic and require a flexible mindset and can-do attitude to get the job done.

How you'll make an impact

• Strategy leadership: Set and implement relevant focus areas and actions in line with the Business Unit and Product Group / Function strategy, HR policies and guidelines.
• Capability/Workforce Planning: Ensure people and organizational capabilities required in the mid-long term are understood and actioned. Apply HR Analytics data to understand key organizational dynamics, trends and issues and define and execute appropriate actions.
• Organizational Design & Developments: Implement the operating model and optimize organization structures and principles in line with group and global rules and standards, including the Hitachi Energy Job Structure.
• Performance Management: Implement group and global business performance standards, KPIs, and targets to help build a high-performance culture in the organization.
• Skill development and Learning: Decide on competence actions to support business strategy in partnership with BU HR Team and Functions. Implement learning and development activities to build and improve technical and leadership competence in collaboration with the HR Talent team.
• Leadership Culture & Talent Management: Identifies and build talent bench strength together with the leaders in the organization. Utilizes Our Leadership Pillars and People360 to help drive culture and behavior by connecting our Behaviors for Scale.
• Standards and governance: Implement and ensure compliance with global and local standards, rules, tools, policies and processes related to operations/project execution.
• Drive recognition and reward programs for individuals and teams linked to the business priorities and C&B guidelines.
• Labor Relations: Partner with managers, union representatives and employees to understand current issues that can be supported or addressed through HR practices, processes, or policies.
• Data management: ensure all necessary data related to our employees are up to date and reflected in our IT systems.

Background

• Proven years of Human Resource generalist experience, including experience in production environment, ideally gained in a global, multi-national matrix environment.
• Strong track record in transformation, organizational and talent development as well as capability building.
• Proven ability to effectively coach employees and manage complex and difficult issues.
• Strong problem solver with the ability to thrive in an ambiguous and rapidly changing environment and strong problem-solving ability.
• Excellent communicator and collaborator who leads by influence
• Strong data literacy with the ability to transform data into meaningful insights that drive business performance and decision-making
• Labor relations experience in a union environment is a plus.
• Fluent German and English are essential for this role.

Il ruolo offre una combinazione unica di influenza strategica e impatto operativo, supportando una forza lavoro diversificata che spazia alla produzione, R&D, ingegneria, supply chain, vendite e funzioni aziendali. Lei guiderà, allenatore e mentore una piccola squadra di rapporti diretti e indiretti.

Per questo ruolo di leadership HR altamente visibile, siamo alla ricerca di un esperto professionista HR che ha idealmente lavorato all'interno di complessi ambienti produttivi o industriali e ha un forte track record in trasformazione e sviluppo organizzativo, e la capacità di influenzare a tutti i livelli, dal piano del negozio al team esecutivo.

I nostri ruoli di Hitachi Energy sono come mani su, in quanto sono strategici e richiedono una mentalità flessibile e può-fare atteggiamento per ottenere il lavoro fatto.

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Leader della strategia: Impostare e implementare aree di messa a fuoco rilevanti e azioni in linea con la strategia Business Unit e Product Group / Function, politiche HR e linee guida.
• Capacità / Pianificazione delle forze di lavoro: Assicurare le persone e le capacità organizzative necessarie nel medio-lungo termine sono comprese e attuate. Applicare i dati di HR Analytics per comprendere le dinamiche organizzative chiave, le tendenze e i problemi e definire ed eseguire azioni appropriate.
• Progettazione organizzativa & Developments: implementare il modello operativo e ottimizzare le strutture e i principi organizzativi in linea con le regole e gli standard di gruppo e globali, tra cui la struttura Hitachi Energy Job.
• Gestione delle prestazioni: Gruppo di implementazione e standard globali delle prestazioni aziendali, KPI e obiettivi per contribuire a costruire una cultura ad alte prestazioni nell'organizzazione.
• Sviluppo e apprendimento delle competenze: decidere sulle azioni di competenza per sostenere la strategia aziendale in collaborazione con BU HR Team e Funzioni. AttivitÃ di apprendimento e sviluppo per costruire e migliorare le competenze tecniche e di leadership in collaborazione con il team HR Talent.
• Leadership Cultura & Talent Management: Identificare e costruire la forza della panchina del talento insieme ai leader dell'organizzazione. Utilizza la nostra Leadership Pillars e People360 per aiutare a guidare la cultura e il comportamento collegando i nostri Comportatori per la Scala.
• Standard e governance: implementare e garantire il rispetto di standard globali e locali, regole, strumenti, politiche e processi relativi alle operazioni/esecuzione dei progetti.
• Guidare i programmi di riconoscimento e ricompensa per le persone e le squadre legate alle priorità aziendali e alle linee guida C&B.
• Rapporti del lavoro: Partner con manager, rappresentanti sindacali e dipendenti per comprendere i problemi attuali che possono essere supportati o affrontati attraverso pratiche, processi o politiche HR.
• Gestione dei dati: assicurarsi che tutti i dati necessari relativi ai nostri dipendenti siano aggiornati e riflessi nei nostri sistemi IT.

Contesto

• Prove anni di esperienza generalista delle risorse umane, compresa l'esperienza nell'ambiente di produzione, idealmente acquisita in un ambiente di matrice globale e multinazionale.
• Forte track record in trasformazione, sviluppo organizzativo e talento così come la costruzione di capacità.
• Prove capacità di allenare efficacemente i dipendenti e gestire problemi complessi e difficili.
• Forte problem solving con la capacità di prosperare in un ambiente ambiguo e in rapida evoluzione e forte capacità di problem solving.
• Ottimo comunicatore e collaboratore che guida l'influenza
• Forte alfabetizzazione dei dati con la capacità di trasformare i dati in insight significativi che guidano le prestazioni aziendali e il processo decisionale
• L'esperienza dei rapporti di lavoro in un ambiente sindacale è un vantaggio.
• Tedesco fluente e inglese sono essenziali per questo ruolo.

L'opportunité

En tant que partenaire mondial RH pour notre entreprise GPG Semiconductor, vous soutiendrez une organisation mondiale à travers la Suisse, la République tchèque, la Chine, l'Inde et les Philippines. Ce rôle fait partie de notre Unité d'Intégration de Grille et vous serez membre de l'équipe de gestion des semi-conducteurs et de l'équipe de leadership RH de l'Intégration de Grille.

Cette occasion vous permet de vous associer directement au chef du Groupe d'affaires mondial pour stimuler la croissance des entreprises, le développement du leadership, l'efficacité organisationnelle et les résultats en matière de talents.

Ce rôle offre une combinaison unique d'influence stratégique et d'impact opérationnel, appuyant une main-d'oeuvre diversifiée couvrant la fabrication, la R-D, l'ingénierie, la chaîne d'approvisionnement, les ventes et les fonctions organisationnelles. Vous dirigerez, coacherez et encadrerez une petite équipe de rapports directs et indirects.

Pour ce rôle de leadership RH très visible, nous recherchons un professionnel des RH expérimenté qui a idéalement travaillé dans des environnements industriels ou manufacturiers complexes et qui a une solide expérience dans la transformation et le développement organisationnel, et la capacité d'influencer à tous les niveaux, de l'atelier à l'équipe de direction.

Nos rôles chez Hitachi Energy sont autant de mains, car ils sont stratégiques et nécessitent une attitude flexible et peuvent faire le travail.

Comment vous ferez un impact

• Leadership stratégique: Définir et mettre en œuvre les domaines d'intervention et les mesures pertinentes conformément à la stratégie de l'unité opérationnelle et du groupe de produits/fonction, aux politiques et aux lignes directrices en matière de RH.
• Capacités/Planification de la main-d'oeuvre : Veiller à ce que les ressources humaines et organisationnelles requises à moyen terme soient comprises et mises en oeuvre. jobs.title: Service Sales Manager (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Die Möglichkeit
Bei Hitachi Energy treiben wir eine nachhaltige Energiezukunft für alle voran. Zur Verstärkung unseres Servicegeschäfts in der Schweiz suchen wir eine erfahrene, kundenorientierte Persönlichkeit im Service Sales Management, die unser Serviceportfolio in der deutsch- und französischsprachigen Schweiz weiterentwickelt und langfristiges Wachstum ermöglicht.

In dieser Rolle sind Sie nahe am Markt und an unseren Kunden. Sie bauen vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf, verstehen technische und kommerzielle Kundenbedürfnisse und entwickeln gemeinsam mit internen Fachbereichen überzeugende Servicelösungen. Dabei begleiten wir unsere Kunden über den gesamten Lebenszyklus ihrer Hochspannungsanlagen und leisten einen wichtigen Beitrag zu einer sicheren, zuverlässigen und nachhaltigen Stromversorgung in der Schweiz.

Das können Sie bewirken

• Sie entwickeln und realisieren Vertriebsstrategien für das Servicegeschäft in den zugewiesenen Regionen und tragen aktiv zur Erreichung unserer Wachstums- und Vertriebsziele bei
• Sie identifizieren und entwickeln neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten für unser Serviceportfolio, einschliesslich Wartung, Retrofit, technischer Beratung, digitaler Lösungen und weiterer wertschöpfender Services
• Sie bauen nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen zu Entscheidungsträgern und relevanten Stakeholdern auf und positionieren Hitachi Energy als verlässlichen Partner über den gesamten Anlagenlebenszyklus
• Sie steuern den gesamten Vertriebsprozess – von der Bedarfsanalyse über die Angebotserstellung und Verhandlung bis hin zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss
• Sie arbeiten eng mit technischen Expertinnen und Experten, Projektmanagement, Operations und weiteren internen Teams zusammen, um kundenorientierte und umsetzbare Lösungen sicherzustellen
• Sie erstellen überzeugende Angebote und Präsentationen, die den Mehrwert unserer Servicelösungen klar aufzeigen und auf die spezifischen Anforderungen unserer Kunden zugeschnitten sind
• Sie beobachten Markt- und Technologietrends, Kundenanforderungen sowie das Wettbewerbsumfeld und leiten daraus relevante Vertriebschancen ab
• Sie stellen eine transparente Pipeline-Steuerung, zuverlässige Forecasts und regelmässige Berichterstattung über Vertriebsaktivitäten und Zielerreichung sicher
• Sie vertreten unser Serviceportfolio mit Überzeugung und tragen dazu bei, die Position von Hitachi Energy als führender Technologie- und Servicepartner im Schweizer Energiemarkt weiter zu stärken
Ihr Hintergrund

• Abgeschlossenes Studium in Betriebswirtschaft, Ingenieurwesen, Marketing oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich
• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Servicevertrieb, idealerweise in der Energie Branche
• Ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Kundenbedürfnisse, Marktmechanismen und die Anforderungen an eine zuverlässige Energieinfrastruktur
• Freude am Kundenkontakt, hohe Dienstleistungsorientierung, kommerzielles Gespür und die Fähigkeit, Energieinfrastruktur technische Anforderungen in überzeugende Kundenlösungen zu übersetzen
• Sehr gute Kommunikations-, Präsentations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten sowie ein professionelles Auftreten gegenüber Kunden und internen Stakeholdern
• Sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, vorzugsweise Salesforce, SAP sowie den gängigen Microsoft-Office-Anwendungen
• Erfahrung in der Erstellung, Analyse und Anwendung von Vollkostenmodellen zur Bewertung von Serviceangeboten, Margen und kommerziellen Entscheidungsgrundlagen
• Bereitschaft zu regelmässiger Reisetätigkeit innerhalb der Schweiz
• Eigenverantwortliche, strukturierte und ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in einem internationalen und interdisziplinären Umfeld
• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (B2) sowie gute Französischkenntnisse (B1); Englischkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld werden erwartet
Mehr über uns
Hitachi Energy ist ein weltweit führendes Technologieunternehmen, das eine nachhaltige Energiezukunft für alle vorantreibt. Wir bedienen Kunden aus Energieversorgung, Industrie und Infrastruktur mit innovativen Lösungen und Services entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Bei uns arbeiten Sie in einem vielfältigen, inklusiven und kollaborativen Umfeld, in dem Sie Ihre Erfahrung einbringen, Verantwortung übernehmen und die Energiewende aktiv mitgestalten können.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La possibilità
In Hitachi Energy, stiamo guidando un futuro energetico sostenibile per tutti. Al fine di rafforzare il nostro business dei servizi in Svizzera, stiamo cercando una personalità esperta e orientata al cliente nella gestione delle vendite di servizi, che svilupperà ulteriormente il nostro portafoglio di servizi in Svizzera tedesca e francofona e consentirà una crescita a lungo termine.

In questo ruolo, siete vicini al mercato e ai nostri clienti. Costruirono relazioni di fiducia, comprendono le esigenze dei clienti tecnici e commerciali e sviluppano soluzioni di servizio convincenti insieme a aree specializzate interne. Accompagniamo i nostri clienti in tutto il ciclo di vita dei loro sistemi ad alta tensione e contribuiamo in modo importante ad un alimentatore sicuro, affidabile e sostenibile in Svizzera.

Possono farlo.

• svilupperai e implementerai strategie di vendita per il business dei servizi nelle regioni assegnate e contribuirai attivamente al raggiungimento dei nostri obiettivi di crescita e di vendita
• Identificherai e svilupperai nuove opportunità di business per il nostro portafoglio di servizi, tra cui manutenzione, retrofit, consulenza tecnica, soluzioni digitali e altri servizi a valore aggiunto
• Costruisci relazioni sostenibili con i decisori e le parti interessate rilevanti e posiziona Hitachi Energy come partner affidabile in tutto il ciclo di vita degli impianti
• Si controlla l'intero processo di vendita – dall'analisi delle esigenze alla preparazione e negoziazione alla conclusione riuscita del contratto
• Lavorano a stretto contatto con esperti tecnici, project management, operazioni e altri team interni per garantire soluzioni orientate al cliente e attuabili
• Crea offerte e presentazioni convincenti che mostrano chiaramente il valore aggiunto delle nostre soluzioni di servizio e si adattano alle specifiche esigenze dei nostri clienti
• Essi osservano le tendenze del mercato e della tecnologia, i requisiti del cliente e l'ambiente competitivo e derivano le opportunità di vendita rilevanti da loro.
• Assicurare il controllo trasparente delle tubazioni, previsioni affidabili e report periodici sulle attività di vendita e sul raggiungimento degli obiettivi
• Rappresentano il nostro portafoglio di servizi con convinzione e contribuiscono a rafforzare ulteriormente la posizione di Hitachi Energy come partner leader nella tecnologia e nei servizi nel mercato dell’energia svizzera
Il tuo sfondo

• Studi completi in amministrazione aziendale, ingegneria, marketing o un campo comparabile
• Diversi anni di esperienza nelle vendite di servizi, idealmente nel settore energetico
• Forte comprensione delle esigenze del cliente, dei meccanismi di mercato e dei requisiti di un'infrastruttura energetica affidabile
• Sfruttamento del contatto con il cliente, alto orientamento del servizio, fascino commerciale e la capacità di tradurre i requisiti tecnici dell'infrastruttura energetica in soluzioni convincenti del cliente
• Molto buone capacità di comunicazione, presentazione e negoziazione, nonché un approccio professionale ai clienti e agli stakeholder interni
• Gestione sicura dei sistemi CRM, preferibilmente Salesforce, SAP e le comuni applicazioni Microsoft Office
• Esperienza nella creazione, analisi e applicazione di modelli full-cost per valutare offerte di servizio, margini e principi decisionali commerciali
• Volontà di viaggiare regolarmente in Svizzera
• Metodi di lavoro auto-responsabili, strutturati e orientati al risultato, nonché il godimento della cooperazione in un ambiente internazionale e interdisciplinare
• Conoscenza molto buona del tedesco (B2) e buona conoscenza del francese (B1); le competenze in inglese sono attesi per la cooperazione in un ambiente internazionale
Ulteriori informazioni su di noi
Hitachi Energy è un leader tecnologico globale che guida un futuro energetico sostenibile per tutti. Serviamo clienti di approvvigionamento energetico, industria e infrastrutture con soluzioni e servizi innovativi lungo tutta la catena del valore. Con noi, si lavora in un ambiente diversificato, inclusivo e collaborativo dove è possibile contribuire alla vostra esperienza, assumersi la responsabilità e modellare attivamente la transizione energetica.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The possibility
At Hitachi Energy, we are driving a sustainable energy future for everyone. In order to strengthen our service business in Switzerland, we are looking for an experienced, customer-oriented personality in service sales management, who will further develop our service portfolio in German- and French-speaking Switzerland and enable long-term growth.

In this role, you are close to the market and to our customers. They build trusting relationships, understand technical and commercial customer needs and develop convincing service solutions together with internal specialist areas. We accompany our customers throughout the entire life cycle of their high-voltage systems and make an important contribution to a secure, reliable and sustainable power supply in Switzerland.

They can do that.

• You will develop and implement sales strategies for the service business in the assigned regions and actively contribute to achieving our growth and sales goals
• You will identify and develop new business opportunities for our service portfolio, including maintenance, retrofit, technical consulting, digital solutions and other value-added services
• You build sustainable customer relationships with decision makers and relevant stakeholders and position Hitachi Energy as a reliable partner throughout the entire plant lifecycle
• You control the entire sales process – from the needs analysis to the preparation and negotiation to the successful conclusion of the contract
• They work closely with technical experts, project management, operations and other internal teams to ensure customer-oriented and actionable solutions
• You create convincing offers and presentations that clearly show the added value of our service solutions and are tailored to the specific requirements of our customers
• They observe market and technology trends, customer requirements and the competitive environment and derive relevant sales opportunities from them.
• Ensure transparent pipeline control, reliable forecasts and regular reporting on sales activities and target achievement
• They represent our service portfolio with conviction and contribute to further strengthening Hitachi Energy’s position as a leading technology and service partner in the Swiss energy market
Your background

• Completed studies in business administration, engineering, marketing or a comparable field
• Several years of experience in service sales, ideally in the energy industry
• Strong understanding of customer needs, market mechanisms and the requirements of a reliable energy infrastructure
• Enjoyment of customer contact, high service orientation, commercial flair and the ability to translate energy infrastructure technical requirements into convincing customer solutions
• Very good communication, presentation and negotiation skills as well as a professional approach to customers and internal stakeholders
• Secure handling of CRM systems, preferably Salesforce, SAP and the common Microsoft Office applications
• Experience in creating, analysing and applying full-cost models to evaluate service offerings, margins and commercial decision-making principles
• Willingness to travel regularly within Switzerland
• Self-responsible, structured and result-oriented working methods as well as enjoyment of cooperation in an international and interdisciplinary environment
• Very good knowledge of German (B2) and good knowledge of French (B1); English skills are expected for cooperation in an international environment
More about us
Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader driving a sustainable energy future for all. We serve customers from energy supply, industry and infrastructure with innovative solutions and services along the entire value chain. With us, you work in a diverse, inclusive and collaborative environment where you can contribute your experience, take responsibility and actively shape the energy transition.

jobs.title: Project Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

We are looking for a Project Engineer to strengthen our polymer machining and processing business in Klingnau. In this role, you will play a key part in driving manufacturing excellence through process optimization, quality assurance, and the successful execution of engineering projects. Working closely with customers and cross-functional teams, you will take ownership of technically challenging projects from concept through implementation, including the design and development of components, tooling, and technical solutions using CAD. If you bring experience in engineering project management, strong CAD capabilities, and a passion for turning technical concepts into practical manufacturing solutions, we look forward to hearing from you.

How you'll make an impact

• Provide technical support for sales, procurement, and production, troubleshoot manufacturing issues, and develop and validate tooling and work instructions to ensure stable, repeatable manufacturing processes
• Manage internal and external customer development projects, define milestones and technical deliverables, and coordinate trials and implementation activities with production, quality, maintenance, sales, procurement, and AVOR
• Introduce and continuously improve production processes, define and validate manufacturing parameters, identify production bottlenecks, and implement improvements to equipment, layouts, and workflows to reduce scrap, rework, downtime, and cycle times
• Plan, coordinate, and perform mechanical, electrical, and thermal testing of materials and components for product development and quality assurance, including specimen preparation and test setup, in accordance with approved procedures and applicable requirements
• Evaluate test results and prepare detailed technical reports and documentation to meet customer and internal requirements
• Investigate product and process deviations using structured root-cause analysis, define corrective actions, and verify their effectiveness through testing and production data
• Create and maintain CAD drawings and 3D models for components, assemblies, tooling, and test fixtures, including dimensions, tolerances, and material specifications, and updating documentation following design or process changes
• Ensure compliance with applicable safety, quality, and environmental requirements in design, laboratory, and production activities, and support the review, documentation, and approval of technical changes before implementation
• Support the implementation and continuous improvement of management systems in accordance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001

Your background

• Engineering qualification in mechanical, production, industrial engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
• Min 2 years of relevant professional experience in a manufacturing or engineering environment
• Proficiency in CAD software and the creation and interpretation of technical drawings
• Good understanding of manufacturing processes, production equipment, tooling, and process validation
• Strong expertise in plastics and composite materials is an advantage
• Proven experience managing engineering projects and coordinating technical activities across cross-functional teams
• Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and effectively with laboratory, production, and business stakeholders
• Fluent German and English language skills are required
• Practical experience in measurement technology and mechanical, electrical, and thermal laboratory testing, including data analysis, test documentation, and technical report writing
• Structured problem-solving mindset and experience with continuous improvement methodologies; Lean or Six Sigma knowledge is an advantage
More about us

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Stiamo cercando un Project Engineer per rafforzare il nostro business di lavorazione e lavorazione dei polimeri a Klingnau. In questo ruolo, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella guida dell'eccellenza manifatturiera attraverso l'ottimizzazione dei processi, l'assicurazione della qualità e l'esecuzione di successo dei progetti di ingegneria. Lavorando a stretto contatto con i clienti e i team interfunzionali, prenderete la proprietà di progetti tecnicamente impegnativi dal concetto attraverso l'implementazione, tra cui la progettazione e lo sviluppo di componenti, utensili e soluzioni tecniche utilizzando CAD. Se portate esperienza nella gestione dei progetti di ingegneria, capacità CAD forti e una passione per trasformare i concetti tecnici in soluzioni pratiche di produzione, non vediamo l'ora di sentire da voi.

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Fornire supporto tecnico per le vendite, l'approvvigionamento e la produzione, risolvere i problemi di produzione, e sviluppare e convalidare le istruzioni di utensili e lavoro per garantire processi produttivi stabili e ripetibili
• Gestire progetti di sviluppo del cliente interno ed esterno, definire pietre miliari e tecnici consegnabili, e coordinare le prove e le attività di implementazione con produzione, qualità, manutenzione, vendite, approvvigionamento e AVOR

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

We are looking for a Project Engineer to strengthen our polymer machining and processing business in Klingnau. In this role, you will play a key part in driving manufacturing excellence through process optimization, quality assurance, and the successful execution of engineering projects. Working closely with customers and cross-functional teams, you will take ownership of technically challenging projects from concept through implementation, including the design and development of components, tooling, and technical solutions using CAD. If you bring experience in engineering project management, strong CAD capabilities, and a passion for turning technical concepts into practical manufacturing solutions, we look forward to hearing from you.

How you'll make an impact

• Provide technical support for sales, procurement, and production, troubleshoot manufacturing issues, and develop and validate tooling and work instructions to ensure stable, repeatable manufacturing processes
• Manage internal and external customer development projects, define milestones and technical deliverables, and coordinate trials and implementation activities with production, quality, maintenance, sales, procurement, and AVOR
• Introduce and continuously improve production processes, define and validate manufacturing parameters, identify production bottlenecks, and implement improvements to equipment, layouts, and workflows to reduce scrap, rework, downtime, and cycle times
• Plan, coordinate, and perform mechanical, electrical, and thermal testing of materials and components for product development and quality assurance, including specimen preparation and test setup, in accordance with approved procedures and applicable requirements
• Evaluate test results and prepare detailed technical reports and documentation to meet customer and internal requirements
• Investigate product and process deviations using structured root-cause analysis, define corrective actions, and verify their effectiveness through testing and production data
• Create and maintain CAD drawings and 3D models for components, assemblies, tooling, and test fixtures, including dimensions, tolerances, and material specifications, and updating documentation following design or process changes
• Ensure compliance with applicable safety, quality, and environmental requirements in design, laboratory, and production activities, and support the review, documentation, and approval of technical changes before implementation
• Support the implementation and continuous improvement of management systems in accordance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001

Your background

• Engineering qualification in mechanical, production, industrial engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
• Min 2 years of relevant professional experience in a manufacturing or engineering environment
• Proficiency in CAD software and the creation and interpretation of technical drawings
• Good understanding of manufacturing processes, production equipment, tooling, and process validation
• Strong expertise in plastics and composite materials is an advantage
• Proven experience managing engineering projects and coordinating technical activities across cross-functional teams
• Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and effectively with laboratory, production, and business stakeholders
• Fluent German and English language skills are required
• Practical experience in measurement technology and mechanical, electrical, and thermal laboratory testing, including data analysis, test documentation, and technical report writing
• Structured problem-solving mindset and experience with continuous improvement methodologies; Lean or Six Sigma knowledge is an advantage
More about us

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.

Wir glauben, dass großartige Arbeit in einem Umfeld gedeiht, in dem sich die Menschen wirklich unterstützt und belohnt fühlen. descriptionByLocale.fr:

jobs.description:
The opportunity

We are looking for a Secondary Design Engineer to join our GIS engineering team. This role is ideal for candidates who have completed an apprenticeship (EFZ) in electrical engineering, automation, or a related discipline and have gained 2–3 years of experience in engineering design or drafting.
As part of our engineering team, you will create electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation for high-voltage GIS substation projects. You will collaborate with experienced engineers, project managers, and global engineering teams while developing your expertise in engineering standards, tools, and technologies. The role offers a clear development path towards greater technical ownership and responsibility within an international engineering environment.

How you'll make an impact

• Prepare schematics and related engineering documents for GIS secondary engineering scopes, including LCC and digital substation applications
• Support engineering execution across project phases, from base design and detail design through manufacturing documentation and as-built updates
• Create preliminary BOMs, reports, and manufacturing documents using approved engineering tools and standard processes
• Perform structured self-checks and contribute to technically correct, high-quality, and standard-compliant deliverables
• Support technical clarifications with internal stakeholders, project teams, and factories, and help document and close open points
• Contribute to continuous improvement, standardization, and engineering best practices, including participation in relevant expert communities
• Apply internal guidelines, engineering standards, and quality requirements while supporting safe and efficient project execution
Your background

• Completed apprenticeship (EFZ) as an Electrical Draftsman, Automation Technician, Electrical Technician, or a comparable electrical engineering qualification
• 2–3 years of professional experience in electrical engineering design, drafting, automation, or engineering project execution
• Further education such as Technician School (HF), Technical College, or equivalent continuing education is preferred
• A Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering may be considered, but this role is intentionally targeted at technicians and engineering professionals with hands-on design experience rather than advanced academic profiles
• Good understanding of electrical engineering principles and interest in high-voltage substations and GIS technology
• Ability to read, understand, and create electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and engineering documentation
• Experience with CAD or engineering software is required
• Structured and reliable working style with attention to detail
• Good teamwork and communication skills
• Good English skills; German is an advantage
More about us

Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader advancing a sustainable energy future for all. You will work in a collaborative and international environment where innovation, learning, and continuous improvement are part of everyday work.

L'opportunità

Stiamo cercando un ingegnere di progettazione secondaria per unirsi al nostro team di ingegneria GIS. Questo ruolo è ideale per i candidati che hanno completato un apprendistato (EFZ) in ingegneria elettrica, automazione, o una disciplina correlata e hanno guadagnato 2-3 anni di esperienza nella progettazione o nella stesura di ingegneria.
Nell'ambito del nostro team di ingegneria, creerai schemi elettrici, diagrammi di cablaggio e documentazione tecnica per progetti di sottostazione GIS ad alta tensione. Potrai collaborare con esperti ingegneri, project manager e team di ingegneria globale, sviluppando le tue competenze in standard ingegneristici, strumenti e tecnologie. Il ruolo offre un chiaro percorso di sviluppo verso una maggiore proprietà tecnica e responsabilità in un ambiente di ingegneria internazionale.

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Preparare gli schemi e i relativi documenti di ingegneria per gli ambiti di ingegneria secondaria GIS, comprese le applicazioni di sottostazione LCC e digitale
• Supporta l'esecuzione dell'ingegneria nelle fasi del progetto, dal design di base e dal design dei dettagli attraverso la documentazione di produzione e gli aggiornamenti as-built
• Creare BOM preliminari, report e documenti di produzione utilizzando strumenti di ingegneria approvati e processi standard
• Eseguire autocontrolli strutturati e contribuire a tecnicamente corretto, di alta qualità e standard-conformables
• Sostenere chiarimenti tecnici con gli stakeholder interni, i team di progetto e le fabbriche, e aiutare a documentare e chiudere punti aperti
• Contribuire al miglioramento continuo, alla standardizzazione e alle migliori pratiche ingegneristiche, inclusa la partecipazione a comunità di esperti rilevanti
• Applicare linee guida interne, standard di ingegneria e requisiti di qualità, supportando l'esecuzione di progetti sicura ed efficiente
Il tuo sfondo

• Apprendistato completo (EFZ) come progettista elettrico, tecnico di automazione, tecnico elettrico o una qualifica di ingegneria elettrica comparabile
• 2-3 anni di esperienza professionale nella progettazione di ingegneria elettrica, redazione, automazione o esecuzione di progetto di ingegneria
• È preferibile un'ulteriore formazione come la Scuola Tecnica (HF), il Collegio Tecnico o l'istruzione permanente equivalente
• Una laurea in ingegneria elettrica può essere considerato, ma questo ruolo è intenzionalmente mirato a tecnici e professionisti di ingegneria con esperienza di progettazione hands-on piuttosto che profili accademici avanzati
• Buona comprensione dei principi di ingegneria elettrica e interesse per le sottostazioni ad alta tensione e la tecnologia GIS
• Capacità di leggere, comprendere e creare schemi elettrici, schemi di cablaggio e documentazione ingegneristica
• L'esperienza con il software CAD o di ingegneria è necessaria
• Stile di lavoro strutturato e affidabile con attenzione ai dettagli
• Buon lavoro di squadra e capacità di comunicazione
• Buone competenze in inglese; il tedesco è un vantaggio
Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

Hitachi Energy è un leader tecnologico globale che promuove un futuro energetico sostenibile per tutti. Si lavorerà in un ambiente collaborativo e internazionale dove innovazione, apprendimento e miglioramento continuo fanno parte del lavoro quotidiano.

L'opportunité

Nous cherchons un ingénieur de conception secondaire pour rejoindre notre équipe d'ingénierie SIG. Ce rôle est idéal pour les candidats qui ont terminé un apprentissage (EFZ) en génie électrique, l'automatisation ou une discipline connexe et ont acquis de 2 à 3 ans d'expérience en conception ou en rédaction d'ingénierie.
Dans le cadre de notre équipe d'ingénierie, vous créerez des schémas électriques, des schémas de câblage et de la documentation technique pour les projets de sous-station SIG à haute tension. Vous collaborerez avec des ingénieurs expérimentés, des gestionnaires de projets et des équipes d'ingénierie mondiale tout en développant votre expertise en normes, outils et technologies d'ingénierie. Ce rôle offre une voie de développement claire vers une plus grande appropriation et responsabilité techniques dans un environnement d'ingénierie international.

Comment vous allez avoir un impact

• Préparer des schémas et des documents techniques connexes pour les champs d'application du génie secondaire du SIG, y compris les applications LCC et les sous-stations numériques
• Soutenir l'exécution de l'ingénierie dans toutes les phases du projet, depuis la conception de base et la conception de détail jusqu'à la documentation de fabrication et les mises à jour réalisées
• Créer des BOM préliminaires, des rapports et des documents de fabrication à l'aide d'outils d'ingénierie approuvés et de procédés normalisés
• Effectuer des autovérifications structurées et contribuer à des résultats techniquement corrects, de haute qualité et conformes aux normes
• Appuyer les clarifications techniques avec les intervenants internes, les équipes de projet et les usines, et aider à documenter et fermer les points ouverts
• Contribuer à l'amélioration continue, à la normalisation et aux pratiques exemplaires en matière d'ingénierie, y compris la participation à des communautés d'experts pertinentes
• Appliquer les directives internes, les normes d'ingénierie et les exigences de qualité tout en favorisant l'exécution sûre et efficace des projets
Vos antécédents

• Apprentissage terminé (EFZ) en tant que dessinateur électrique, technicien d'automatisation, technicien électrique ou une qualification comparable en génie électrique
• 2–3 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans la conception, la rédaction, l'automatisation ou l'exécution de projets d'ingénierie électrique
• La formation continue, comme l'École des techniciens (HF), le Collège technique ou l'enseignement continu équivalent, est préférable.
• Un baccalauréat en génie électrique peut être envisagé, mais ce rôle vise intentionnellement les techniciens et les professionnels de l'ingénierie ayant une expérience pratique de conception plutôt que des profils universitaires avancés
• Bonne compréhension des principes du génie électrique et intérêt pour les sous-stations à haute tension et la technologie SIG
• Capacité de lire, comprendre et créer des schémas électriques, des diagrammes de câblage et de la documentation technique
• Une expérience de CAO ou de logiciel d'ingénierie est requise
• Style de travail structuré et fiable avec attention aux détails
• Bonnes compétences en travail d'équipe et en communication
• Bonnes compétences en anglais; l'allemand est un avantage
Plus sur nous

Hitachi Energy est un chef de file mondial en matière de technologie pour la promotion d'un avenir énergétique durable pour tous. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement collaboratif et international où l'innovation, l'apprentissage et l'amélioration continue font partie du travail quotidien.

• Varie attività con responsabilità personale

• Un team collegiale con brevi percorsi decisionali

• Condizioni di lavoro interessanti e opportunità di sviluppo
descriptionByLocale.en:
About the position
In this responsible and dynamic role, you will be responsible for one shift of production at MICAFIL in Altstetten (ZH), ensuring that we continue to strengthen our competitiveness and develop our Swiss subsidiary to meet global market growth. Through your clear communication and open personality, you continuously develop the teams and processes. With strategic foresight and technical know-how, you will support production team leaders and develop sustainable solutions that take quality, efficiency and competitiveness to the next level. If you have a passion for process optimization, we offer you the opportunity to significantly shape the future of our location.

They can do that.

• Responsible for a shift team in the production environment, including resource management and team development in a 3-shift operating model (direct management, 10-15 FTE)

• Ensuring a continuous and high production output in close coordination with the factory planners and the production manager

• Responsibility within the layer for safety, quality and productivity

• Documentation of layer performance and transfer to subsequent layers

• Support for the training of new employees in the production process

• Identification and integration of new technologies and best practices to drive the continuous improvement (CIP) process together with our Process Engineering Team

• Reduction of the Committee to a minimum

• Improvement and training of work & maintenance instructions to ensure 3-shift operation

• Monitoring Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for success measurement and feedback to the production manager

This is what they bring with them.

• Technical education and training (TS / HF) in the field of engineering, leadership or a comparable field

• Several years of professional experience in production, ideally in shift operation

• In-depth knowledge of Lean Management, Six Sigma and other process optimization methods

• Strong problem-solving skills and data-driven decision-making

• Excellent skills in time management, communication and organization, as well as the ability to prioritize and meet deadlines

• Flowing in German, English is an advantage

More about us

• Secure workplace in a future-oriented company

• Varied tasks with personal responsibility

• A collegial team with short decision paths

• Attractive employment conditions and development opportunities

jobs.title: R&D Senior Engineer Switchgear Monitoring & Automation 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Join our Technology Center and play a key role in the development of a next-generation monitoring platform for high-voltage switchgear applications. In this position, you will act as the technical lead for a multidisciplinary product development project, defining system requirements and architecture while collaborating with global R&D teams and external engineering partners.

You will work in an international environment, partnering with colleagues across Switzerland, Sweden, and Asia, as well as with external development teams to deliver innovative embedded monitoring solutions.

How you'll make an impact

• Define system requirements for new monitoring products
• Create product architectures for embedded platforms
• Evaluate technologies and recommend technical solutions
• Lead technical activities across hardware, firmware, and software teams
• Collaborate with external development partners and internal experts
• Drive system integration, validation, and testing activities
• Support cybersecurity and data protection requirements
• Act as the technical counterpart to the Project Manager
Your background

• Degree in Electrical Engineering, Embedded Engineering, or similar
• Several years of experience in embedded product development
• Experience with requirements engineering and system architecture
• Knowledge of electronics, firmware, software, integration, and testing
• Experience working in international R&D environments
• Strong communication skills and fluent English
More about us

This role offers the opportunity to work on a strategic product platform with global visibility and long-term impact. You will collaborate with international teams and external technology partners while contributing to innovative solutions for the power industry.

Potential future career paths include Project Management and Product Management.

For any questions regarding this position, please contact the Talent Acquisition Partner responsible for the recruitment process.

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Electrical technician in research high voltage lab 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description:

As high voltage lab engineer, you are a full member of a dynamic team of scientists and technicians working to shape the future technology to be used in high voltage products.
In this position, you can test innovative ideas, implement new measurement and diagnostics methods, while you maintain a functional and safe testing environment.
Come and join our team if you are interested in the field of high voltage technology and work towards a sustainable and exciting future in energy.
